reading.cn: 梅在航班起飞前两个小时到达机场。她走到飞往伦敦的航班的登机柜台。“早上好，先生。我办理飞往伦敦的BA286航班的登机手续。”梅说。工作人员微笑着说：“早上好。请出示您的护照好吗？”梅递给他护照。“谢谢。您有行李需要托运吗？”他问。“是的，就这一个手提箱。”梅回答。工作人员把手提箱放在秤上。“它有点超重，但这次没关系。”他说。梅松了一口气。“您喜欢靠过道的座位还是靠窗的座位？”他问。“请给我一个靠过道的座位。”梅回答。工作人员打印了她的登机牌。“这是您的登机牌。您的登机口是A10，登机时间是上午9:45。祝您旅途愉快！”他说。梅谢过他，走向安检。
reading.en: Mei arrived at the airport two hours before her flight. She walked to the check-in counter for her flight to London. “Good morning, sir. I’m checking in for flight BA286 to London,” Mei said. The agent smiled and said, “Good morning. May I see your passport, please?” Mei handed him her passport. “Thank you. Do you have any luggage to check?” he asked. “Yes, just this one suitcase,” Mei replied. The agent put the suitcase on the scale. “It’s a little overweight, but it’s okay this time,” he said. Mei felt relieved. “Would you prefer an aisle seat or a window seat?” he asked. “An aisle seat, please,” Mei answered. The agent printed her boarding pass. “Here is your boarding pass. Your gate is A10, and boarding starts at 9:45 AM. Have a good flight!” he said. Mei thanked him and walked towards security.

reading.cn: 梅找到了她的登机口A10。她查看了离境显示屏以确认信息。一切都正确。她买了一杯咖啡，舒服地等待着。很快，登机广播响了。她排队并出示了她的登机牌。她对她的伦敦之行很兴奋。
reading.en: Mei found her gate, A10. She checked the departure board to confirm the information. Everything was correct. She bought a coffee and waited comfortably. Soon, the announcement for boarding was made. She joined the line and showed her boarding pass. She was excited about her trip to London.

reading.cn: 登机后，梅找到了她的靠过道座位。她把小包放在头顶的行李架上。她安顿下来，期待着她的新冒险。
reading.en: After boarding, Mei found her aisle seat. She put her small bag in the overhead compartment. She settled down and looked forward to her new adventure.

reading.cn: 梅终于抵达伦敦，并轻松找到出机场的路。她已准备好探索这座城市。
reading.en: Mei finally arrived in London and easily found her way out of the airport. She was ready to explore the city.

reading.cn: 梅今天非常忙。她的老板李先生昨天给了她一个大项目。“梅，你必须在今天下午5点前完成这份报告，”他说。梅看了看她的待办事项清单。有太多事情了。首先，她必须查看新邮件。然后，她必须给一位客户打电话，安排一个紧急会议。之后，她必须为明天的团队演示做准备。还有那份报告！事情真多。梅知道她不能浪费任何时间。“我必须集中精力，”她心想。
reading.en: Mei has a very busy day ahead. Her boss, Mr. Lee, gave her a big project yesterday. "Mei, you have to finish this report by 5 PM today," he said. Mei looked at her to-do list. There were so many things. First, she had to check the new emails. Then, she had to call a client for an urgent meeting. After that, she must prepare for the team presentation tomorrow. And the report! It was a lot. Mei knew she couldn't waste any time. "I have to focus," she thought.

reading.cn: 她决定从报告开始，因为那是最重要的。“我今天必须完成这个，”她告诉自己。她把手机调成静音，以避免任何干扰。她的同事汤姆走过来。“嘿，梅，想去喝杯咖啡吗？”他问。“哦，我很乐意，汤姆，但我现在不能。我必须完成这份报告。这是优先事项，”梅回答。汤姆理解了。梅叹了口气，知道她今天没有午休时间了。她必须确保在截止日期前一切都完美无缺。
reading.en: She decided to start with the report as it was the most urgent. "I must finish this today," she told herself. She put her phone on silent to avoid any distractions. Her colleague, Tom, walked by. "Hey, Mei, want to grab some coffee?" he asked. "Oh, I'd love to, Tom, but I can't right now. I have to finish this report. It's a priority," Mei replied. Tom understood. Mei sighed, knowing there would be no lunch break for her today. She had to ensure everything was perfect before the deadline.

reading.cn: 到下午4点半，梅差不多完成了。她最后一次检查了所有的细节。就在她准备发送的时候，李先生出现了。“完成了吗？”他问。“是的，李先生。我正在发送，”梅笑着说。她发出了邮件。她肩上的一块大石头终于放下了。“干得好，梅！”李先生拍了拍她的背。梅笑了。她必须努力工作，但这是值得的。现在，她终于可以考虑去喝咖啡了！
reading.en: By 4:30 PM, Mei was almost done. She checked all the details one last time. Just as she was about to send it, Mr. Lee appeared. "Is it finished?" he asked. "Yes, Mr. Lee. I'm just sending it now," Mei said with a smile. She sent the email. A big weight lifted from her shoulders. "Good job, Mei!" Mr. Lee patted her back. Mei smiled. She had to work hard, but it was worth it. Now, she could finally think about that coffee!

reading.cn: 发送报告后，梅还有一些事情要做，但它们没有那么紧急了。她需要为明天的团队演示做准备，并跟进一些邮件。“我今晚必须整理演示文稿的笔记，”她想。尽管那份大报告完成了，但她的一天还没有完全结束。但至少最大的压力已经消失了。
reading.en: After sending the report, Mei still had a few things to do, but they were not as urgent. She needed to prepare for the team presentation tomorrow and follow up on some emails. "I have to organize my notes tonight for the presentation," she thought. Even though the big report was done, her day wasn't completely over. But at least the biggest pressure was gone.

grammar.title: Obligations: Must vs. Have to

grammar.explain:
在英语中，might, may 和 could 都可以用来表示对未来或当前事态的“可能性”推测。它们都属于情态动词 (modal verbs)。

1.  **Might**: 表示可能性相对较低，或者语气比较不确定。它通常用于表达一种猜测。
    *   结构：主语 + might + 动词原形
2.  **May**: 与 might 相似，也表示可能性，但有时被认为可能性略高于 might，或者语气更正式一些。在口语中，may 和 might 经常可以互换使用，差别不大。
    *   结构：主语 + may + 动词原形
3.  **Could**: 也可以表示可能性，尤其是在疑问句和否定句中，它可以指“也许会”或“可能不是”。在表示可能性时，could 和 might/may 意思相近，但 could 还可以表示“能力”。
    *   结构：主语 + could + 动词原形

reading.cn: 周五早上，梅正在和她的寄宿家庭妈妈史密斯夫人讨论周末计划。“史密斯夫人，我们周六还去野餐吗？”梅问道。史密斯夫人看了看手机。“嗯，明天的天气预报说下午可能会下雨。可能不是大雨，但可能会有点多云潮湿。”梅看起来很失望。“哦，不！我真的很期待。”史密斯夫人笑了笑。“别担心，梅。如果下雨，我们总可以在室内野餐，或者我们也可以去博物馆。我们明天早上查看最新的预报后再决定。现在，如果你今天出门，记得带把伞，因为今天下午也可能会下雨！
reading.en: It's Friday morning, and Mei is talking to her host mother, Mrs. Smith, about the weekend plans. "Mrs. Smith, are we still going for a picnic on Saturday?" Mei asked. Mrs. Smith looked at her phone. "Hmm, the weather forecast for tomorrow says it might rain in the afternoon. It may not be heavy rain, but it could be a bit cloudy and wet." Mei looked disappointed. "Oh, no! I was really looking forward to it." Mrs. Smith smiled. "Don't worry, Mei. If it rains, we can always have an indoor picnic, or maybe we could go to the museum instead. We'll decide tomorrow morning after checking the latest forecast. For now, just remember to bring an umbrella if you go out today, as it might rain this afternoon too!"

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅正准备去见一个朋友。“梅，你带伞了吗？”史密斯夫人在厨房里喊道。“哦，我忘了！谢谢您提醒我，史密斯夫人。可能下雨，所以最好做好准备。”梅拿起雨伞出门了。她希望周六的天气能适合她们的野餐，但她知道有时候计划需要改变。这是一个很好的学习灵活应变的教训！
reading.en: Later that day, Mei was getting ready to meet a friend. "Are you taking your umbrella, Mei?" Mrs. Smith called from the kitchen. "Oh, I forgot! Thanks for reminding me, Mrs. Smith. It might rain, so it's better to be prepared." Mei grabbed her umbrella and headed out. She hoped the weather would be good for their picnic on Saturday, but she knew sometimes plans needed to change. It was a good lesson in being flexible!

reading.cn: 第二天早上，天空晴朗。“好消息，梅！”史密斯夫人开心地说。“预报变了。说今天会整天阳光明媚！我们肯定可以去野餐了！”梅非常高兴。“太棒了！我去准备野餐篮！
reading.en: The next morning, the sky was clear. "Good news, Mei!" Mrs. Smith said cheerfully. "The forecast changed. It says it will be sunny all day! We can definitely have our picnic!" Mei was thrilled. "That's wonderful! I'll get the picnic basket ready!"

reading.cn: 梅上周在网上订了一本新书。她很期待阅读。昨天，她查看了派送状态。网站显示：“包裹昨天已送达。”梅跑到她的邮箱查看，但里面是空的。她查看了自家门廊周围，也问了她的寄宿家庭，但没有人看到。梅很困惑。她决定打电话给客服。“我的包裹昨天送到了，但我没有收到，”她解释道。客服代表查看了她的追踪号码，说：“有时候，包裹会误送到错误的地址。别担心，我们会帮你找到它。”梅希望她的书能尽快找到。
reading.en: Mei ordered a new book online last week. She was very excited to read it. Yesterday, she checked the delivery status. The website said, "The package was delivered yesterday." Mei went to her mailbox, but it was empty. She looked around her porch and asked her host family, but no one saw it. Mei was confused. She decided to call customer service. "My package was delivered yesterday, but I didn't receive it," she explained. The customer service representative checked her tracking number and said, "Sometimes, packages are delivered to a wrong address by mistake. Don't worry, we will help you find it." Mei hoped her book would be found soon.

reading.cn: 梅又等了两天。客服给她回了电话。“好消息，梅！您的包裹找到了。它不小心送到了您邻居家，”客服代表说。梅松了一口气！她迅速去了邻居家。邻居微笑着把书递给她。“这个是送给我送错了，”邻居说。“我今天晚些时候本来准备给您送过去。”梅感谢了她的邻居和客服。最终，她的新书终于到手了！她迫不及待地想开始阅读。
reading.en: Mei waited two more days. The customer service called her back. "Good news, Mei! Your package was found. It was accidentally delivered to your neighbor's house," said the representative. Mei was so relieved! She quickly went to her neighbor's door. Her neighbor smiled and handed her the book. "This was delivered to me by mistake," the neighbor said. "I was going to bring it over later today." Mei thanked her neighbor and customer service. Finally, her new book was in her hands! She couldn't wait to start reading.

reading.cn: 梅很高兴最终拿到她的书。她学到了关于网上购物和包裹投递的重要一课。虽然问题可能会发生，但客服会提供帮助，有时，好心的邻居也能帮忙解决问题。现在，梅知道即使包裹显示“已送达”，如果丢失了，最好还是仔细检查并寻求帮助。她很感谢所有帮助她的人。
reading.en: Mei was happy to finally have her book. She learned an important lesson about online shopping and deliveries. While problems can happen, customer service is there to help, and sometimes, kind neighbors can save the day. Now, Mei knows that even if a package shows as "delivered," it's good to double-check and ask for help if it's missing. She was grateful for everyone who helped her.

reading.cn: 从今以后，梅会一直妥善保管她的追踪号码。她也计划在等待包裹时更有耐心。如果出了问题，她知道该怎么做：联系客服并向邻里寻求帮助。她的经历告诉她，沟通和一点耐心会非常有益。
reading.en: From now on, Mei will always keep her tracking numbers safe. She also plans to be more patient when waiting for deliveries. And if something goes wrong, she knows what to do: contact customer service and look for friendly faces in her neighborhood. Her experience taught her that communication and a little bit of patience go a long way.

grammar.title: Say vs. Tell
grammar.explain:
在间接引语中，say 和 tell 都可以用来引导转述，但它们的用法略有不同。

- Say 后面可以直接跟转述内容，或跟 that 从句。
- Tell 后面通常需要先跟一个宾语（告诉某人），然后再跟转述内容或 that 从句。

reading.cn: 梅和她的朋友莉莉课后聊天。莉莉看起来有点沮丧。梅问：“莉莉，怎么了？”莉莉叹了口气说：“我累了。今晚还有好多作业要做。”梅点点头，提议说：“如果你愿意，我可以帮你。”莉莉笑了笑：“梅，你真好。但我想我需要自己做。也许我只是需要一杯咖啡。”梅回答说：“好的。那我们去喝咖啡吧！你说你累了，所以咖啡也许会有帮助。
reading.en: Mei and her friend, Lili, were chatting after class. Lili looked a little down. Mei asked, "What's wrong, Lili?" Lili sighed and said, "I'm tired. I have so much homework to do tonight." Mei nodded and offered, "I can help you if you want." Lili smiled, "That's very kind of you, Mei. But I think I need to do it myself. Maybe I just need a cup of coffee." Mei replied, "Okay. Let's go get some coffee then! You said you were tired, so maybe coffee will help."

listening.audio: Mei woke up with a sore throat and a slight headache. She's had a cough for a day too. She called her friend to tell her she was not feeling well. Her friend told her to rest and drink warm water. Mei decided to see a doctor in the afternoon.

reading.cn: 梅醒来时感觉不舒服。她喉咙痛，还有点头痛。她小心翼翼地起床，感到有些头晕。“我今天可能去不了上班了，”她想。她记起自己要去见医生，需要清楚地描述自己的症状。“我喉咙痛两天了，还咳嗽，”她练习着说。“希望不是严重的流感。”
reading.en: Mei woke up feeling unwell. Her throat was sore, and she had a slight headache. She carefully got out of bed, feeling a bit dizzy. "I don't think I can go to work today," she thought. She remembered the doctor's appointment she had to describe her symptoms clearly. "I've had a sore throat for two days, and I also have a cough," she practiced saying. "I hope it's not a serious flu."

reading.cn: 那天早上晚些时候，梅给她的朋友莎拉打电话。“嗨，莎拉，我感觉很不舒服，”梅说，声音有点沙哑。“哦不，怎么了？”莎拉问。“我喉咙痛两天了，还咳得很厉害，”梅解释道。“我还感到头晕，有点低烧。我担心可能是流感。”莎拉建议道，“你肯定应该去看医生。多喝温水，好好休息！”
reading.en: Later that morning, Mei called her friend, Sarah. "Hey Sarah, I'm feeling really sick," Mei said, her voice a little hoarse. "Oh no, what's wrong?" Sarah asked. "I've had a sore throat for two days, and I have a bad cough," Mei explained. "I also feel dizzy and have a slight fever. I'm worried it might be the flu." Sarah suggested, "You should definitely see a doctor. Drink plenty of warm water, and get some rest!"

reading.cn: 那天下午，梅去了诊所。医生很和蔼，仔细听她描述。 “那么，梅，你有什么症状？”医生问。梅描述了一切：“我喉咙痛两天了，很疼。我还咳嗽，头痛，感觉有点头晕。昨天晚上我还发烧了。”医生检查了她的喉咙，听了听她的胸部。“听起来像普通感冒，但我们会做一个快速检查以确保，”医生说。“我会开一些药来缓解你的症状。记住要多休息，多喝水。”
reading.en: Mei went to the clinic in the afternoon. The doctor was kind and listened carefully to her. "So, what are your symptoms, Mei?" the doctor asked. Mei described everything: "I've had a sore throat for two days, and it's quite painful. I also have a cough, a headache, and I feel a bit dizzy. And yesterday evening, I had a slight fever." The doctor checked her throat and listened to her chest. "It sounds like a common cold, but we'll do a quick test to be sure," the doctor said. "I'll prescribe some medicine for your symptoms. Remember to rest a lot and drink fluids."

reading.cn: 看医生后，梅感觉好了一些。她从药房取了药，然后直接回家。她泡了一些加了蜂蜜和柠檬的暖茶，然后躺在床上。“我很高兴我去看医生了，”她想。“现在我知道该怎么做了。”她希望明天能感觉好多了。
reading.en: Mei felt a little better after visiting the doctor. She picked up her medicine from the pharmacy and went straight home. She made some warm tea with honey and lemon, then settled into bed. "I'm glad I went to the doctor," she thought. "Now I know what to do." She hoped to feel much better by tomorrow.

reading.cn: 这是纽约市一个典型的冬日早晨。梅正往窗外看，冷得发抖。“哇，外面真冷！”她自言自语道。她的寄宿家庭妈妈戴维斯夫人走进厨房。“早上好，梅！你准备好上学了吗？”梅回答说：“差不多了，但外面看起来好冷！我应该穿什么？”戴维斯夫人微笑着说：“你肯定需要穿上一件暖和的外套、一条围巾，也许还要戴上手套。别忘了你的帽子！保暖很重要。”梅点点头，“谢谢你，戴维斯夫人！我也会穿上我的靴子。我不想感冒。”
reading.en: It's a typical winter morning in New York City. Mei is looking out the window, shivering. "Wow, it's freezing outside!" she says to herself. Her host mother, Mrs. Davis, comes into the kitchen. "Good morning, Mei! Are you ready for school?" Mei replies, "Almost, but it looks so cold! What should I wear?" Mrs. Davis smiles. "You definitely need to put on a warm coat, a scarf, and maybe some gloves. And don't forget your hat! It's important to stay warm." Mei nods, "Thanks, Mrs. Davis! I'll put on my boots too. I don't want to catch a cold."

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅正走去学校。风很大，但她穿着多层衣服很暖和。她看到一个朋友莉莉，莉莉正在等公交车。莉莉只穿了一件薄外套。“莉莉，你不冷吗？”梅问道。莉莉打了个哆嗦。“有点。我忘了我的外套和围巾。我真应该听天气预报的。”梅分享道：“我的寄宿妈妈总是告诉我，天冷的时候要穿上外套。这真的很有用！”莉莉同意说：“你说得对。我需要回家拿我的暖和衣服。我不想生病！”
reading.en: Later that day, Mei is walking to school. The wind is biting, but she's warm in her layers. She sees a friend, Lily, who is waiting for the bus. Lily is only wearing a light jacket. "Lily, aren't you cold?" Mei asks. Lily shivers. "A little. I forgot my coat and scarf. I really should have listened to the weather forecast." Mei shares, "My host mom always tells me to put on a coat when it's freezing. It really helps!" Lily agrees, "You're right. I need to get home and grab my warm clothes. I don't want to get sick!"

reading.cn: 回家的路上，梅经过一家小咖啡馆。她想喝点暖和的。她走进咖啡馆，点了一杯热巧克力。咖啡馆里暖和又舒适，是躲避严寒天气的好地方。她想到穿合适的衣服应对天气是多么重要。“我很高兴今天穿了外套和靴子，”她心想，“现在我可以真正享受我的热巧克力，而不会感到冷了。”
reading.en: On her way home, Mei passes a small café. She feels like having something warm. She goes inside and orders a hot chocolate. It's warm and cozy inside, a nice escape from the freezing weather. She thinks about how important it is to dress properly for the weather. "I'm glad I put on my coat and boots today," she thinks. "Now I can really enjoy my hot chocolate without feeling cold."

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅醒来查看天气。外面仍然很冷，但没有那么冻人。“是时候选择我今天穿的衣服了，”她说。她决定穿一件毛衣和一件背心，并带了一件薄外套以防万一。她正在学习如何应对变幻莫测的纽约天气。“关键在于做好准备！”她微笑着说。
reading.en: The next morning, Mei wakes up and checks the weather. It's still cold, but not freezing. "Time to choose my outfit for the day," she says. She decides to wear a sweater and a vest, and brings a light jacket just in case. She's learning to manage the unpredictable New York weather. "It's all about being prepared!" she smiles.

reading.cn: 梅正在机场等她的航班。她想打电话给她的寄宿家庭，告诉他们她晚点了。她看了看手机，屏幕是黑的。“哦，不！”她惊呼道，“我的手机没电了！”她疯狂地翻找着包，但她找不到充电器，也没有充电宝。她问附近的一位机场工作人员，“打扰一下，您知道附近有没有电源插座吗？我的手机电池完全没电了。”工作人员指向5号登机口附近的一个充电站。梅赶紧走过去，插上手机充电，希望能有足够的电量打电话。
reading.en: Mei was at the airport, waiting for her flight. She wanted to call her host family to let them know about her delay. She looked at her phone, and the screen was black. "Oh no!" she exclaimed, "My phone just died!" She searched her bag frantically, but she couldn't find her charger or her power bank. She asked a nearby airport official, "Excuse me, do you know if there's an outlet anywhere? My phone battery is completely dead." The official pointed to a charging station near Gate 5. Mei quickly walked there and plugged in her phone, hoping to get enough power to make her call.

reading.cn: 几分钟后，梅的手机终于有足够的电量开机了。她赶紧打电话给她的寄宿家庭，告诉他们新的到达时间。他们很高兴接到她的电话，并说他们会等她。梅松了一口气。在重要时刻手机没电真是太令人沮丧了！
reading.en: After a few minutes, Mei's phone finally had enough power to turn on. She quickly called her host family to tell them the new arrival time. They were happy to hear from her and said they would wait. Mei felt relieved. It's really frustrating when your phone dies at an important moment!

reading.cn: 梅在机场找到了一个充电站。她插上手机。几分钟后，她的手机终于开机了。她打电话给寄宿家庭，告诉他们航班延误了。她感到松了一口气。
reading.en: Mei found a charging station at the airport. She plugged in her phone. After a few minutes, her phone finally turned on. She called her host family and told them about the delay. She felt relieved.

reading.cn: 她很高兴找到了一个插座。
reading.en: She was so glad to find an outlet.

listening.audio: Mei was at her friend's house until late. She rushed to the bus stop, but the last bus had already left. "Oh no, I missed the last bus!" she said. "What should I do now? It's too late for another bus, and a taxi is too expensive." Her friend suggested, "You can stay here, or call Sarah. She lives nearby." Mei called Sarah, and luckily, Sarah said yes. Mei was so relieved. She stayed at Sarah's place and took an early bus home the next morning.

reading.cn: 梅在朋友家。时间过得很快。她看了看手表。“哦不！快到午夜了！我得回家了。”她的朋友送她到公交车站。他们等啊等，但公交车一直没来。梅看了看手机。“哦，不！我错过了末班车！我该怎么办？”她的朋友建议说：“你可以打辆出租车，或者你今晚可以在这里睡。”梅想了一会儿。“出租车太贵了。我问问我的朋友莎拉，我能不能睡在她家的沙发上。她就住附近。”她很快给莎拉打了电话。幸运的是，莎拉同意了。梅松了一口气。
reading.en: Mei was at her friend's house. Time passed quickly. She looked at her watch. "Oh no! It's almost midnight! I need to go home." Her friend walked her to the bus stop. They waited and waited. No bus came. Mei checked her phone. "Oh, no! I missed the last bus! What should I do?" Her friend suggested, "You can take a taxi, or you can sleep here tonight." Mei thought for a moment. "A taxi is too expensive. I'll ask my friend Sarah if I can stay on her couch. She lives nearby." She quickly called Sarah. Luckily, Sarah said yes. Mei was so relieved.

reading.cn: 梅感谢了她的朋友，然后开始走路去莎拉家。有点冷，但不是很远。她很高兴自己找到了交通问题的解决方案。下次她会早点查看公交车时刻表。
reading.en: Mei thanked her friend and started walking to Sarah's place. It was a bit cold, but not too far. She was happy that she found a solution to her transportation problem. Next time, she would check the bus schedule earlier.

reading.cn: 梅到了莎拉的公寓，按响了门铃。莎拉带着温暖的笑容打开了门。“进来吧，梅！没问题。我的沙发超级舒服。”梅非常感激。她知道她有很棒的朋友。
reading.en: Mei got to Sarah's apartment and rang the doorbell. Sarah opened the door with a warm smile. "Come in, Mei! No problem at all. My couch is super comfy." Mei was so grateful. She knew she had good friends.

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅醒来时感觉精神焕发。“莎拉，再次感谢你收留我！”她说。“不客气！很高兴能帮上忙，”莎拉回答道。梅随后搭乘早班公交车回了家。
reading.en: The next morning, Mei woke up feeling refreshed. "Thanks again for letting me stay, Sarah!" she said. "No worries! Glad I could help," Sarah replied. Mei then took an early bus home.

reading.cn: 梅在一家咖啡店。享受完咖啡后，她走到柜台付钱。“你好，”她说，“我能用现金支付吗？”咖啡师微笑着说：“抱歉，我们今天只接受刷卡或手机支付。”梅有点失望。“哦，我现在只带了现金。附近有银行可以取钱吗？”咖啡师指着说：“有，街对面就有一个自动取款机，在小杂货店旁边。”梅谢过他，迅速去了自动取款机。她用银行卡取了一些现金，然后回来付了咖啡钱。
reading.en: Mei is at a coffee shop. After enjoying her coffee, she goes to the counter to pay. "Hi," she says, "Can I pay in cash?" The barista smiles and says, "Sorry, we only accept card or mobile payment today." Mei is a bit disappointed. "Oh, I only have cash with me right now. Is there a bank nearby where I can withdraw some money?" The barista points, "Yes, there's an ATM right across the street, next to the small grocery store." Mei thanks him and quickly goes to the ATM. She uses her card to withdraw some cash, then comes back to pay for her coffee.

reading.cn: 梅和她的朋友莉莉在一家新餐厅。服务员走到他们的桌旁。“晚上好！你们准备好点餐了吗？”他问道。梅微笑着说：“还没，谢谢。可以给我看一下菜单吗？”服务员递给他们两份菜单。莉莉看着梅。“你打算吃什么？”梅回答说：“我还不确定。每样看起来都很棒！你推荐什么？”服务员无意中听到了他们的话，说：“我们今天的特色菜是烤三文鱼。”梅想了一会儿。“听起来很美味！我的主菜就点那个吧，谢谢。再来一杯橙汁。”莉莉决定点一份意面。饭后，他们享用了一块苹果派作为甜点。吃完后，梅问道：“我们可以买单了吗？”他们付了钱，并为优质的服务留下了一笔丰厚的小费。
reading.en: Mei was at a new restaurant with her friend, Lily. The waiter approached their table. "Good evening! Are you ready to order?" he asked. Mei smiled. "Not yet, thank you. Could I see the menu, please?" The waiter handed them two menus. Lily looked at Mei. "What are you thinking of having?" Mei replied, "I'm not sure. Everything looks good! What do you recommend?" The waiter overheard them and said, "Our special today is the grilled salmon." Mei thought for a moment. "That sounds delicious! I'll have that as my main course, please. And a glass of orange juice." Lily decided to order a pasta dish. After their meal, they enjoyed a slice of apple pie for dessert. When they finished, Mei asked, "Could we have the bill, please?" They paid and left a generous tip for the excellent service.

reading.cn: 后来，梅和莉莉讨论了她们的用餐体验。“我真的很喜欢那个烤三文鱼！”梅说。莉莉同意道：“是啊，食物很棒，服务也很好。”梅补充说：“能知道一些点餐的短语真好。‘Could I see the menu, please?’ 和 ‘Could we have the bill, please?’ 非常有用。”莉莉点点头。“没错！这些表达让外出就餐变得容易多了。”
reading.en: Later, Mei discussed her dining experience with Lily. "I really liked the grilled salmon!" Mei said. Lily agreed, "Yes, the food was great, and the service was excellent too." Mei added, "It's good to know some phrases for ordering food. 'Could I see the menu, please?' and 'Could we have the bill, please?' were very useful." Lily nodded. "Definitely! These expressions make dining out so much easier."

reading.cn: 第二天，梅去了一家不同的咖啡馆吃早餐。她想尝试一些新东西。服务员过来时，她自信地说：“早上好！可以给我看一下菜单吗？”她看了看菜单，然后点了一份糕点和一杯咖啡。在餐厅里用英语她感觉更自在了。她知道熟能生巧。
reading.en: The next day, Mei went to a different cafe for breakfast. She wanted to try something new. When the waiter came, she confidently said, "Good morning! Could I see the menu, please?" She looked at the menu and then ordered a pastry and a coffee. She felt more comfortable using English in a restaurant setting. She knew that practice makes perfect.

reading.cn: 离开咖啡馆前，梅特意留下了一点小费。她记得莉莉说的关于优质服务的话。“谢谢！”她在离开时对服务员说。梅为自己的进步感到自豪。她觉得自己真的变得越来越独立了。
reading.en: Before leaving the cafe, Mei made sure to leave a small tip. She remembered Lily's words about good service. "Thank you!" she said to the waiter as she left. Mei was proud of her progress. She felt she was truly becoming more independent.

grammar.explain: 当我们想表达对某事物的偏好时，可以使用 prefer 或 would rather。它们可以表示更喜欢某种事物，或者宁愿做某事。
prefer 可以用于表达更喜欢一个事物胜过另一个事物。常见用法是 prefer A to B，表示“相比 B 更喜欢 A”。

reading.cn: 梅正在和她的寄宿家庭吃早餐。电视开着，播放着早间新闻。“梅，你看到这个头条新闻了吗？”史密斯太太问。“据新闻报道，一个新的社区中心下个月就要开放了。”梅看向屏幕。“哦，那真是个好消息！我昨天在当地报纸上看到一篇关于它的文章。”史密斯先生补充道，“是的，报道说它会有一个图书馆和一个健身房。这对我们城市的时事发展是件好事。”梅笑了。“看来我又有了一个练习英语的新地方了！”
reading.en: Mei was having breakfast with her host family. The TV was on, showing the morning news. "Did you see this headline, Mei?" asked Mrs. Smith. "According to the news, a new community center is opening next month." Mei looked at the screen. "Oh, that’s great news! I saw an article about it in the local paper yesterday." Mr. Smith added, "Yes, the report says it will have a library and a gym. It's good for current events in our city." Mei smiled. "Looks like I'll have a new place to practice English!"

reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅在线上和她的朋友汤姆聊天。“嘿汤姆，根据我今天早上看的新闻报道，新的社区中心很快就要开放了！”汤姆回复道，“真的吗？太棒了！我上周听广播提到过，但我没有听到所有细节。你信息的来源是什么？”梅回复道，“我的寄宿家庭告诉我的，而且我还读了报纸上的文章。它开放的时候我们绝对应该去！”
reading.en: Later that day, Mei chatted with her friend, Tom, online. "Hey Tom, according to the news I saw this morning, the new community center will open soon!" Tom replied, "Really? That's awesome! I heard a broadcast about it last week, but I didn't get all the details. What's the source of your information?" Mei typed back, "My host family told me, and I also read an article in the paper. We should definitely go when it opens!"

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅渴望分享更多。她在网上又找到了一篇文章。头条写着：“社区中心将提供免费课程。”她很快给汤姆发信息，“好消息！根据这篇文章，新的社区中心将提供免费英语课程！”汤姆很兴奋。“那更好了！我们可以一起去！”
reading.en: The next morning, Mei was eager to share more. She found another article online. The headline read, "Community Center to Offer Free Classes." She quickly messaged Tom, "Good news! According to this article, the new community center will have free इंग्लिश classes!" Tom was excited. "That's even better! We can go together!"

reading.cn: 晚餐时，梅和她的寄宿家庭分享了她的兴奋之情。“根据报道，社区中心将提供免费课程，包括英语！”史密斯太太笑了。“太棒了，梅！我很高兴你关注这里时事。这是了解你的新城市和练习英语的好方法。”梅点点头，对她的新发现感到高兴。
reading.en: Mei shared her excitement with her host family at dinner. "According to the report, the community center will have free classes, including English!" Mrs. Smith smiled. "That's wonderful, Mei! I'm glad you're following the current events here. It's a great way to learn about your new city and practice your English." Mei nodded, feeling happy about her new findings.

grammar.explain:
当我们对别人的观点或感受表示赞同，或者有相同喜好时，可以用 “So do I” 和 “Me neither”。

1. **So do I**：用于肯定句，表示“我也一样”。
2. **Me neither**：用于否定句，表示“我也不”。

reading.en: Mei woke up feeling a little strange. Her head felt heavy, and her throat was a bit scratchy. "I'm feeling under the weather," she thought. She slowly got out of bed and went to the kitchen. Her host mother, Mrs. Davis, was already there, making breakfast. "Good morning, Mei. How are you feeling this morning?" Mrs. Davis asked kindly. Mei sighed, "I'm afraid I'm not feeling very well, Mrs. Davis. I think I have a sore throat and a bit of a headache." Mrs. Davis put her hand on Mei's forehead. "Oh dear, you feel a little warm. Perhaps you have a slight fever. You should really get some rest today. I can make you some warm tea and toast." Mei smiled weakly, "That would be lovely, thank you." Mrs. Davis nodded. "Don't worry, we'll take care of you. Just let me know if you need anything else."
reading.cn: 梅醒来时感觉有点不对劲。她的头很沉，喉咙也有些沙哑。她心想：“我有点不舒服。”她慢慢下床去了厨房。她的寄宿家庭妈妈戴维斯太太已经在那里做早餐了。“早上好，梅。今天感觉怎么样？”戴维斯太太亲切地问道。梅叹了口气说：“恐怕我不太舒服，戴维斯太太。我觉得我喉咙痛，还有点头痛。”戴维斯太太把手放在梅的额头上。“哦，亲爱的，你有点发热。可能你有点低烧。你今天真的应该好好休息一下。我可以给你做点热茶和吐司。”梅虚弱地笑了笑说：“那太好了，谢谢您。”戴维斯太太点点头。“别担心，我们会照顾你的。如果你还需要什么，尽管告诉我。”

reading.en: Later that day, Mei felt even more unwell. Mrs. Davis checked on her frequently. She brought Mei a bowl of chicken noodle soup and more hot tea. "Are you still feeling nauseous or dizzy?" Mrs. Davis asked, concerned. "Just a little dizzy when I stand up, but the soup helps," Mei replied. Mrs. Davis said, "If you don't feel better by tomorrow, we should go to the doctor. For now, just focus on resting." Mei was grateful for Mrs. Davis's kindness and care. She knew she was in good hands.
reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅感觉更不舒服了。戴维斯太太经常来看她。她给梅端来一碗鸡肉面条汤和更多的热茶。“你还恶心或头晕吗？”戴维斯太太关切地问道。“站起来时有点头晕，但汤有帮助，”梅回答。戴维斯太太说：“如果明天你还不舒服，我们应该去看医生。现在，就专心休息吧。”梅很感激戴维斯太太的善良和照顾。她知道自己得到了很好的照料。

reading.en: The next morning, Mei woke up feeling much better. Her headache was gone, and her sore throat was only a slight tickle. "I think the rest really helped, Mrs. Davis. I'm feeling almost back to normal!" Mei said happily at breakfast. Mrs. Davis smiled, "That's wonderful to hear, dear! Remember, it's important to take care of yourself when you're not feeling well."
reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅醒来时感觉好多了。她的头痛消失了，喉咙痛也只是一点点痒。梅在早餐时高兴地说：“戴维斯太太，我觉得休息真的很有帮助。我感觉几乎恢复正常了!”戴维斯太太笑道：“听到这个真是太好了，亲爱的！记住，身体不适时照顾好自己很重要。”

reading.en: Mei was very happy that her host family helped her so much, and she knew to ask for help if she felt unwell again.

grammar.explain: little 和 few 都表示“少”，但用法不同。little 用于不可数名词，表示“几乎没有”或“有点少”。a little 也用于不可数名词，表示“有一些”，比 little 强调肯定的数量。few 用于可数名词，表示“几乎没有”。a few 也用于可数名词，表示“有一些”，比 few 强调肯定的数量。

reading.en: Mei was at her homestay family's kitchen table. Her host mother, Mrs. Davis, was preparing breakfast. "Good morning, Mei!" Mrs. Davis smiled. "What would you like for breakfast? We have cereal, toast, and eggs."
reading.cn: 梅坐在寄宿家庭的厨房餐桌旁。她的寄宿妈妈戴维斯夫人在准备早餐。“早上好，梅！”戴维斯夫人微笑着说。“你早餐想吃什么？我们有麦片、吐司和鸡蛋。”

reading.en: Mei felt a little shy. "Good morning, Mrs. Davis. Um, I'd like a little cereal, please." Mrs. Davis poured some cereal into a bowl. "And what about milk? A lot of milk or just a little?" she asked.
reading.cn: 梅有点害羞。“早上好，戴维斯夫人。嗯，我想要一点麦片，谢谢。”戴维斯夫人倒了一些麦片到一个碗里。“那牛奶呢？多一点还是少一点？”她问道。
梅想了想。“就一点牛奶，谢谢。”戴维斯夫人然后指向一个盘子。“你想吃点饼干吗？我昨天烤的。还剩几块。”梅的眼睛亮了。“是的，谢谢！我想要几块饼干！”她说着，感觉更自在了。戴维斯夫人递给她一个装有三块饼干的盘子。
reading.en: Mei thought for a moment. "Just a little milk, please. Thank you." Mrs. Davis then pointed to a plate. "Would you like some cookies? I baked them yesterday. There are a few left." Mei's eyes lit up. "Yes, please! I'd love a few cookies!" she said, feeling more comfortable. Mrs. Davis handed her a plate with three cookies.

reading.cn: 早餐后，梅正在帮戴维斯夫人收拾桌子。“这顿早餐很美味，谢谢您，”梅说。戴维斯夫人笑了笑。“不客气，亲爱的。也许明天你想要一点果汁而不是牛奶？也许再多几块饼干？总是有很多！”梅笑了。“听起来很棒！”
reading.en: After breakfast, Mei was helping Mrs. Davis clear the table. "That was a delicious breakfast, thank you," Mei said. Mrs. Davis smiled. "You're welcome, dear. Perhaps tomorrow you'd like a little juice instead of milk? And maybe a few more cookies? There are always plenty!" Mei laughed. "Sounds great!"

listening.audio: It was a lazy Sunday morning. Suddenly, the doorbell rang loudly. "Someone is at the door," I said to my brother. He got up slowly. "Is anyone there?" he called out. No one answered. He waited for a moment. Then, the bell rang again. "Maybe it's a delivery," I suggested. He cautiously opened the door, but saw no one. Just a small box on the mat. Someone had left a surprise!

output.prompt: Imagine you are home alone and the doorbell rings. Describe what happens. Who is there (or not there)? What do you do?
output.cn: 想象你独自在家，门铃响了。描述发生了什么事。门外是谁（或者没人）？你做了什么？
output.sample: I was watching TV when the doorbell rang. I thought, "Someone is at the door." I looked through the peephole, but there was no one. I was a bit scared. Then I saw a small present on the mat. Someone left a gift for me!

reading.en: It was a quiet afternoon at Mei's home. Suddenly, the doorbell rang. Mei was in the kitchen, making tea. "Someone is at the door," she called to her husband, Li. Li was reading in the living room. He got up and looked through the peephole. "Is anyone there?" he asked. No one answered. He waited. The doorbell rang again. "Maybe it's a delivery," Mei suggested. Li opened the door carefully. There was a big package on the porch, but no one was there. "Well, no one is here now," Li said, picking up the package. "It seems someone left a package for us."
reading.cn: 这是一个安静的下午，梅正在家里。突然，门铃响了。梅在厨房里，正在泡茶。“有人在门口，”她对丈夫李说。李正在客厅里看书。他起身通过猫眼往外看。“有人在吗？”他问道。没人回应。他等了一会儿。门铃又响了。“也许是送货的，”梅建议道。李小心翼翼地打开门。门廊上有一个大包裹，但是没人。李拿起包裹说：“嗯，现在没人在这里了。看来有人给我们留了一个包裹。”

reading.en: Mei smiled. "Good. I was expecting a package today!" They brought the package inside. Li closed the door, feeling a bit relieved. It was strange that no one was waiting. "I wonder who it was," Li said. "Someone probably just dropped it off and left quickly," Mei replied. "At least no one bothered to ring the bell a third time!" They both laughed.
reading.cn: 梅笑了。“太好了。我今天正等着一个包裹呢！”他们把包裹拿进屋。李关上门，感觉松了口气。没有人等着，这有点奇怪。“我不知道是谁，”李说。“可能有人只是放下了就赶紧走了，”梅回答说。“至少没人再按第三次门铃！”他们都笑了。

reading.en: Later that evening, the doorbell rang again. Li looked at Mei. "Someone again?" he whispered. This time, he looked through the peephole first. "It's our neighbor, Mr. Chen," Li said. "He's holding a pie. Someone brought us dessert!" Mei opened the door happily.
reading.cn: 那天晚上晚些时候，门铃又响了。李看着梅。“又是谁？”他小声问。这次，他先从猫眼看了一下。“是我们的邻居陈先生，”李说。“他拿着一个派。有人给我们送甜点了！”梅高兴地打开了门。

reading.en: Mei thanked Mr. Chen for the delicious pie. "No problem!" Mr. Chen said. "My wife made too much, so I said, 'Someone needs to enjoy this!' So here I am!" They all shared the pie and had a lovely evening, remembering the mysterious package from earlier. Sometimes, good things happen when someone is at the door.
reading.cn: 梅感谢陈先生的美味派。“没事！”陈先生说。“我妻子做得太多了，所以我就说，‘总得有人来享受这个！’所以我就来了！”他们一起分享了派，度过了一个愉快的晚上，回想起之前那个神秘的包裹。有时候，当有人在门口时，好事就会发生。

reading.cn: 莉莉刚结束她的假期。她正在和朋友汤姆聊起度假的事。“汤姆，我度过了一个多么美好的假期！每天天气都那么宜人。我们看到了那么多美丽的海滩，大海是那么清澈。多棒的经历啊！我拍了好多照片。哦，食物也超棒！我真的推荐那个地方。真是美好的一段时光！”
reading.en: Lily just finished her vacation. She's talking to her friend, Tom, about it. "Tom, I had such a wonderful vacation! The weather was so lovely every day. We saw such beautiful beaches and the ocean was so clear. What an amazing experience! I took so many photos. Oh, and the food was terrific too! I really recommend that place. What a great time!"

reading.cn: 汤姆笑了。“听起来真让人兴奋，莉莉！我为你玩得这么开心感到高兴。多完美的放松方式啊！我很快也需要一次那样的假期了。那么告诉我，你看到的最令人惊讶的事情是什么？”

reading.cn: 莉莉咯咯地笑了。“嗯，我们浮潜的时候看到了好多五颜六色的鱼。那真是一个奇妙的海底世界！而且当地市场也那么有活力。多热闹的地方啊！”
reading.en: Lily chuckled. "Well, we saw so many colorful fish while snorkeling. It was such a fantastic underwater world! And the local market was so vibrant. What a lively place!"

reading.cn: 汤姆点点头。“哇，多么棒的一次冒险！我真的应该找个时间去那里。真是个好地方！”

reading.en: Mei and her friend, Tom, decided to cook dinner together. "Let's make pasta tonight!" Mei suggested excitedly. "Great idea! I love pasta," Tom replied. "Do we have all the ingredients?" Mei checked the fridge. "Hmm, we have pasta, tomatoes, and some mushrooms. But we need garlic and some fresh basil." Tom volunteered, "I can run to the store quickly." While Tom was out, Mei started chopping the tomatoes and mushrooms. She found a new recipe online for a creamy tomato sauce. "This looks delicious," she thought. When Tom came back, they worked together, mixing the sauce and boiling the pasta. Finally, they sat down to enjoy their homemade meal. "This is so good, Mei!" Tom said, taking a big bite. "We should cook together more often!" Mei smiled, "I agree! It's much more fun." They both felt happy and full.
reading.cn: 梅和她的朋友汤姆决定一起做晚餐。“我们今晚做意面吧！”梅兴奋地建议道。“好主意！我喜欢意面，”汤姆回答。“我们有所有食材吗？”梅检查了一下冰箱。“嗯，我们有意大利面、西红柿和一些蘑菇。但是我们需要大蒜和一些新鲜的罗勒。”汤姆主动说：“我能很快去趟商店。”汤姆出去的时候，梅开始切西红柿和蘑菇。她在网上找到了一份制作奶油番茄酱的新食谱。“这看起来很美味，”她想道。汤姆回来后，他们一起动手，混合酱汁，煮意面。最后，他们坐下来享用他们的家常便饭。“这个真好吃，梅！”汤姆咬了一大口说道。“我们应该更经常一起做饭！”梅笑着说：“我同意！这样有趣多了。”他们都感到又开心又饱足。
梅：今晚我们一起做意面吧！我找到一个很棒的食谱。
reading.en: Mei: Let's cook pasta together tonight! I found a great recipe.

reading.cn: 汤姆：听起来棒极了！我们要做哪种意面？

reading.cn: 梅正在客厅吃早餐。“今天很冷，不是吗？”她对寄宿家庭的妈妈玛丽亚说。玛丽亚笑了。“是的，梅。但等下会暖和起来的，不是吗？天气预报是这么说的。”梅看向窗外。“哦，天气很阴，不是吗？我希望不会下雨。”玛丽亚点点头。“我也是。我们等下要去买菜，不是吗？”梅同意道。“是的，我们要去。而且今天很适合购物，不是吗？”玛丽亚轻笑起来。“好吧，我们希望太阳快点出来吧！”
reading.en: Mei was having breakfast in the living room. "It's cold today, isn't it?" she said to her host mother, Maria. Maria smiled. "Yes, it is, Mei. But it will be warm later, won't it? The weather report said so." Mei looked out the window. "Oh, it's very cloudy, isn't it? I hope it won't rain." Maria nodded. "Me too. We need to go grocery shopping later, don't we?" Mei agreed. "Yes, we do. And it's a nice day for shopping, isn't it?" Maria chuckled. "Well, let's hope the sun comes out!"

reading.cn: 那天早上晚些时候，梅和玛丽亚出门了。太阳出来了，暖和多了。“现在天气很好，不是吗？”梅问。“比之前好多了，”玛丽亚回答。“而且一点风都没有，是吧？我们真幸运。”她们在宜人的天气里享受了购物之旅。
reading.en: Later that morning, Mei and Maria went out. The sun came out, and it was much warmer. "It's nice now, isn't it?" Mei asked. "Much better than before," Maria replied. "And it's not windy at all, is it? We are lucky." They enjoyed their shopping trip in the pleasant weather.

reading.cn: 梅喜欢和玛丽亚谈论天气；这帮助她练习英语。她学会了像“晴朗的”和“多云的”这样的新词，不是吗？而且使用“isn't it?”让她听起来更自然，不是吗？
reading.en: Mei loves talking about the weather with Maria; it helps her practice English. She learns new words like 'sunny' and 'cloudy,' doesn't she? And using 'isn't it?' makes her sound more natural, doesn't it?

grammar.explain:
反意疑问句（Question Tags）是在陈述句后加上一个简短的疑问句，用来征求对方的同意或确认某事。它的构成通常是：陈述句，+ 助动词/情态动词 + 主语代词？

- 如果陈述句是肯定的，反意疑问句通常用否定形式。
- 如果陈述句是否定的，反意疑问句通常用肯定形式。
- 助动词（如 be, do, have）或情态动词（如 can, will, must）要与陈述句中的动词保持一致。
- 主语要用代词形式指代陈述句的主语。

本课核心句型 “It's cold, isn't it?” 就是一个典型的反意疑问句。

reading.en: Mei needed a new jacket. She walked into a clothing store. A sales assistant approached her. "Can I help you?" the assistant asked. Mei smiled. "Yes, please. I'm looking for a jacket." The assistant showed her a few. "We have this blue one and this red one. Which one do you prefer?" Mei looked at both. "Hmm, I think I'll take the red one. Do you have it in a size small?" The assistant checked. "Yes, we do. The changing rooms are right over there. You can try it on." Mei tried on the red jacket. It fit perfectly. She went to the cashier to pay. "This jacket is lovely," she thought.
reading.cn: 梅需要一件新夹克。她走进一家服装店。一位销售助理走过来，问道：“需要帮忙吗？”梅笑了笑。“是的，谢谢。我正在找一件夹克。”助理给她看了几件。“我们有这件蓝色的和这件红色的。你更喜欢哪一件？”梅看了看两件。“嗯，我想我要红色那件。有小码的吗？”助理查看了一下。“是的，有。试衣间就在那边。你可以试穿一下。”梅试穿了那件红色夹克。非常合身。她去收银台付款。“这件夹克真漂亮，”她想道。
后来，梅回到店里买一条配套的裤子。同一个助理向她打招呼。“欢迎回来！你今天想找些什么吗？”梅回答说：“是的，我想要一条黑色正装裤。你们有好的吗？”助理指着一个衣架说：“我们这里有这些。它们很受欢迎。你想试穿一条吗？”梅拿起两条裤子。“我要这两条，试穿一下。”试穿后，她决定了。“我要我试穿的第一条。那条更舒服。”她付了钱离开了，对她的购买很满意。
reading.en: Later, Mei went back to the store for a matching pair of pants. The same assistant greeted her. "Welcome back! Are you looking for something specific today?" Mei replied, "Yes, I'd like a pair of black dress pants. Do you have any good ones?" The assistant pointed to a rack. "We have these here. They're very popular. Would you like to try on a pair?" Mei picked up two pairs. "I'll take these two and try them on." After trying them on, she decided. "I'll take the first one I tried. It's more comfortable." She paid and left, happy with her purchases.

Mei returned to the store a week later with her friend, Li. Li was looking for a new dress. The assistant showed them several options. "We have this floral one, this solid green one, and the striped one over there." Li pointed to a dress. "I like that striped one. Can I try it on in size medium?" The assistant brought the dress. Li tried it on and loved it. Mei also saw a nice scarf. "That patterned one is beautiful, isn't it?" Mei asked. The assistant nodded. "Yes, it's a new arrival." Li ended up buying the striped dress, and Mei bought the patterned scarf. They were both happy with their good choices.
reading.cn: 一周后，梅和她的朋友李一起回到了这家店。李正在寻找一件新连衣裙。助理给她们看了几个选择。“我们有这件碎花的，这件纯绿色的，还有那边那件条纹的。”李指着一件连衣裙说：“我喜欢那件条纹的。我可以试穿一下中码的吗？”助理拿来了那件连衣裙。李试穿后非常喜欢。梅还看到了一条漂亮的围巾。“那条有图案的真漂亮，不是吗？”梅问道。助理点点头。“是的，那是新到的。”李最终买了那件条纹连衣裙，梅买了那条有图案的围巾。她们都对自己的好选择感到满意。

reading.en: Mei was back in the store for a gift for her brother. She was looking at t-shirts. The assistant came over. "Looking for something special?" Mei explained, "Yes, I need a simple t-shirt for my brother. He likes plain colors. Do you have any plain black ones?" The assistant showed her a stack. "We have these. They are very soft. Which one would he prefer?" Mei picked one up. "I think he'd like this one. It feels nice." She paid for the t-shirt, thinking it would be a perfect gift. Mei always enjoyed shopping at this store because of the helpful staff and good selection.

reading.cn: 梅正在上英语课，她想描述自己最喜欢的爱好。“我喜欢……呃……我喜欢……那个词怎么说，就是把颜色画到纸上？”她问老师。“你是说‘paint’吗，梅？”老师回答道。“是的！就是那个词！我喜欢画画。”梅笑着说。后来，她想问一个常见的厨房用品。“那个词是什么来着……你知道的，就是你用来烧水的东西？”梅努力解释。她的同学汤姆回答说：“哦，你是说水壶(kettle)吗？”梅兴奋地点点头：“是的，水壶！我有时就是会忘记单词！”
reading.en: Mei was in her English class, trying to describe her favorite hobby. "I like to... uh... I like to... how do you say that, when you put colors on paper?" she asked her teacher. "Do you mean 'paint' Mei?" replied the teacher. "Yes! That's the word! I like to paint," Mei said with a smile. Later, she wanted to ask about a common kitchen item. "What's the word for... you know, that thing you use to boil water?" Mei tried to explain. Her classmate, Tom, responded, "Oh, you mean a kettle?" Mei nodded excitedly, "Yes, a kettle! Sometimes I just forget the words!"

Mei often found herself struggling to recall specific words. She practiced using phrases like "What's the word for...?" or "How do you say...?" when she was stuck. Her teacher encouraged her to describe the object or action, even if she didn't know the exact word. "Don't worry about forgetting, Mei. It's part of learning. Just try to explain what you mean," her teacher advised.
reading.cn: 梅经常发现自己很难记起一些特定的单词。当她卡壳时，她会练习使用“What's the word for...?”或“How do you say...?”这样的短语。她的老师鼓励她描述物体或动作，即使她不知道确切的单词。“别担心忘记，梅。这是学习的一部分。只管试着解释你的意思。”老师建议道。

reading.en: One day, Mei was talking with her host mother about dinner. "I'm going to make... um... that long, thin food, like pasta, but usually with soup." Her host mother laughed. "Do you mean noodles, dear?" Mei clapped her hands. "Noodles! Yes! I always forget that word!" Mei was getting better at finding ways to communicate, even when she didn't have the exact vocabulary.
reading.cn: 有一天，梅和她的寄宿家庭妈妈聊晚餐。“我要做……嗯……那种长长的、细细的食物，像意大利面，但通常配汤。”她的寄宿家庭妈妈笑了。“你是说面条(noodles)吗，亲爱的？”梅拍了拍手。“面条！是的！我总是忘记那个词！”梅越来越擅长寻找沟通方式，即使她没有准确的词汇。
梅了解到，不知道每个单词是可以的。重要的是要不断尝试沟通，并利用她所拥有的工具，比如请求澄清或描述事物。她随身带着一个小笔记本，记下她学到的新单词和短语。
reading.en: Mei learned that it's okay to not know every word. The important thing is to keep trying to communicate and to use the tools she had, like asking for clarification or describing things. She kept a small notebook to write down new words and phrases she learned.

reading.cn: 梅在一个嘈杂的火车站，正试图买票。噪音太大了。售票员说话语速非常快。梅仔细听着，但她没完全听懂。“不好意思，您能再说一遍吗？”梅礼貌地问道。售票员看着她，表情略显不耐烦。“我说，你要去哪个城市？”梅觉得有点尴尬，但她必须搞清楚。“抱歉，我没太听懂。您能说慢一点吗？”售票员叹了口气，但随后说得更清楚、更慢了。梅终于听懂了并买到了票。
reading.en: Mei was at a busy train station, trying to buy a ticket. The noise was overwhelming. The ticket agent spoke very quickly. Mei listened carefully, but she couldn't quite catch everything. "Excuse me, could you repeat that?" Mei asked politely. The agent looked at her with a slightly impatient expression. "I said, which city are you going to?" Mei felt a little embarrassed but had to be clear. "Sorry, I didn't quite understand. Could you please speak a little more slowly?" The agent sighed, but then spoke more clearly and slowly. Mei finally understood and bought her ticket.

reading.cn: 后来，梅正在寻找她的站台。广播里的通知很不清楚。她问旁边的一位旅客：“抱歉，我没听清广播。去伦敦的火车在哪个站台？”旅客微笑着说：“是7号站台。他们说火车晚点五分钟。”梅点点头，松了口气。当她不明白的时候，寻求澄清很重要。
reading.en: Later, Mei was looking for her platform. An announcement over the loudspeaker was garbled. She asked a nearby traveler, "Sorry, I missed the announcement. What platform is for the train to London?" The traveler smiled, "It's Platform 7. They said the train is delayed by five minutes." Mei nodded, relieved. It was important to ask for clarification when she didn't understand.

listening.audio: Mei went to the front desk. She said, "Excuse me, I'd like to make a complaint. The TV in my room is broken and the air conditioning isn't working properly." The receptionist apologized and called the manager. The manager offered Mei a new room.

reading.cn: 梅女士办理入住酒店，对她的假期充满期待。然而，当她试图打开电视时，电视却没反应。接着，她注意到空调发出的噪音很奇怪，也无法给房间降温。“这和我预期的一点都不一样，”梅女士心想。她决定去前台投诉。“打扰一下，”她对接待员说，“我想投诉一下我的房间。电视坏了，空调也无法正常工作。”接待员道了歉并叫来了经理。经理给梅女士换了一间新房间，或者为她的住宿打折。梅女士选择了新房间，并终于开始享受她的假期。
reading.en: Mei checked into her hotel room, excited for her vacation. However, when she tried to turn on the TV, it didn't work. Then, she noticed the air conditioner was making a strange noise and not cooling the room. "This is not what I expected," Mei thought. She decided to go to the front desk to make a complaint. "Excuse me," she said to the receptionist, "I'd like to make a complaint about my room. The TV is broken and the air conditioning isn't working properly." The receptionist apologized and called the manager. The manager offered Mei a new room or a discount for her stay. Mei chose the new room and finally started to enjoy her vacation.

Later that evening, Mei went to the hotel restaurant for dinner. She ordered a steak, but when it arrived, it was cold. She politely called the waiter. "Excuse me, I'd like to make a complaint about my food. My steak is cold." The waiter immediately took the plate back and brought her a freshly cooked, hot steak. Mei was happy with how the hotel staff handled her complaints.
reading.cn: 那天晚上晚些时候，梅女士去酒店餐厅吃晚餐。她点了一份牛排，但端上来的时候却是冷的。她礼貌地叫来了服务员。“打扰一下，我想投诉一下我的食物。我的牛排是冷的。”服务员立刻把盘子拿回去，给她端来了一份新鲜烹制的热牛排。梅女士对酒店工作人员处理投诉的方式感到满意。
第二天早上，梅想尝试酒店的自助早餐。她发现很多菜都空了，咖啡机也坏了。她叹了口气。这似乎成了常态。她走向早餐主管。“打扰一下，我想投诉一下早餐服务。没有干净的盘子，咖啡机也坏了。”主管迅速采取行动，补充了菜品并修理了咖啡机。梅女士感谢他们的及时回应，并终于吃上了一顿不错的早餐。
reading.en: The next morning, Mei wanted to try the hotel's breakfast buffet. She found that many of the dishes were empty, and the coffee machine was not working. She sighed. This was becoming a pattern. She approached the breakfast supervisor. "Excuse me, I'd like to make a complaint about the breakfast service. There are no clean plates and the coffee machine is broken." The supervisor quickly took action, refilling the dishes and fixing the coffee machine. Mei appreciated their prompt response and finally had a decent breakfast.

reading.cn: 尽管有一些小问题，梅对酒店员工处理投诉的方式印象深刻。他们总是礼貌、细心，并且能迅速解决问题。她了解到，礼貌地投诉可以带来更好的体验。
reading.en: Despite these small issues, Mei was impressed by how the hotel staff handled her complaints. They were always polite, attentive, and quick to resolve the problems. She learned that making a polite complaint can lead to a better experience.

reading.cn: 冬天要来了！我能感觉到。每天早上，天气都越来越冷。太阳下山得更早了，所以天黑得更快。我现在出门需要穿更厚的衣服。白昼越来越短。很快，就要到圣诞节了，一年中最短的一天也将过去。然后，白昼就会开始变长变亮。我等不及再次迎来温暖的天气了！
reading.en: Winter is coming! I can feel it. Every morning, it's getting colder and colder. The sun sets earlier, so it gets darker faster. I need to wear a thicker coat now when I go out. The days are getting shorter. Soon, it will be Christmas, and the shortest day of the year will pass. Then, the days will start to get longer and brighter. I can't wait for warmer weather again!

Mei loves autumn, but she knows winter is just around the corner. She noticed the leaves on the trees are turning red and orange, and falling to the ground. She also realized that the evenings are getting colder, and she needs an extra blanket at night. Her host mom, Mrs. Smith, told her, "The days are getting shorter, Mei. It gets dark around 5 PM now. Soon it will be winter, but don't worry, we have a nice warm fireplace!"
reading.cn: 梅很喜欢秋天，但她知道冬天就在眼前。她注意到树上的叶子正在变红变橙，然后落到地上。她还意识到晚上越来越冷，晚上睡觉需要多盖一条毯子。她的寄宿家庭妈妈史密斯夫人告诉她：“日子越来越短了，梅。现在大约下午 5 点天就黑了。很快就要冬天了，不过别担心，我们有漂亮的暖和的壁炉！”

reading.en: Mei feels a little bit sad because she loves going out in the sunshine. But she likes the fireplace idea! She also loves hot chocolate, and winter is the best time for it. "Yes, it's getting colder, but it's also a cozy time," Mei thought. She is getting stronger in English every day, too, so she can understand more conversations with Mrs. Smith.
reading.cn: 梅有点伤心，因为她喜欢在阳光下外出。但她喜欢壁炉这个主意！她也喜欢热巧克力，冬天是喝热巧克力的最佳时节。“是的，天越来越冷了，但这也是一个舒适的季节，”梅想。她的英语也每天都在进步，所以她能和史密斯夫人进行更多的对话了。

reading.en: Tomorrow, Mei plans to buy a new hat and gloves. "It's getting colder," she reminded herself. She wants to be ready for the winter. She also wants to learn some winter sports, like ice skating. "It's never too late to try new things!" she smiled.
reading.cn: 明天，梅计划买一顶新帽子和手套。“天越来越冷了，”她提醒自己。她想为冬天做好准备。她还想学习一些冬季运动，比如滑冰。“尝试新事物永远不嫌晚！”她笑了。

reading.cn: 梅在一家咖啡馆里，寻找一个座位。这里相当忙碌。她看到一张小桌子有两把椅子，但其中一把椅子上放着一条围巾。梅走近桌子。她想问她是否可以坐下。她看着坐在那里的女士，礼貌地问道：“打扰一下。我坐这儿可以吗？”那位女士微笑着说：“哦，是的，当然可以！这条围巾是给我朋友的，但她稍后才会到。你现在可以坐这个座位。”梅谢过她，坐了下来，很高兴找到了一个享用咖啡的地方。
reading.en: Mei was at a cafe, looking for a place to sit. It was quite busy. She saw a small table with two chairs, but one chair had a scarf on it. Mei approached the table. She wanted to ask if she could sit down. She looked at the woman sitting there and said politely, "Excuse me. Is it okay if I sit here?" The woman smiled and said, "Oh, yes, of course! This scarf is for my friend, but she will be here a little later. You can take this seat for now." Mei thanked her and sat down, happy to have found a spot to enjoy her coffee.

A few minutes later, Mei's friend, Li, arrived. Mei introduced Li to the woman. Li apologized for being late. The woman said, "No problem. There's still an available seat for your friend." Then, Mei, Li, and the woman started a friendly conversation while enjoying their coffee.
reading.cn: 几分钟后，梅的朋友丽到了。梅把丽介绍给那位女士。丽为迟到表示歉意。那位女士说：“没关系。你朋友还有一个空座位可以坐。”然后，梅、丽和那位女士一边享用咖啡，一边开始了友好的交谈。
梅感到很开心，因为她不再害怕提出请求。她明白了一个礼貌的请求可以结交新朋友，让每个人的一天都更美好。
reading.en: Mei felt happy because she wasn't afraid to ask for permission. She learned that a polite request can make new friends and make everyone's day better.

Later that week, Mei was at the library. She saw an empty chair at a table where someone was studying. Mei remembered her cafe experience. She walked up to the table and asked, "Excuse me, is it okay if I sit here?" The student looked up, smiled, and nodded. "Sure, go ahead!" Mei was glad she asked politely.
reading.cn: 那一周晚些时候，梅在图书馆。她看到一张桌边有一个空椅子，旁边有人在学习。梅想起了她在咖啡馆的经历。她走到桌边，问道：“打扰一下，我坐这儿可以吗？”那位学生抬起头，微笑着点点头。“当然，请坐吧！”梅很高兴她礼貌地询问了。

grammar.title: 量词：many 和 much
grammar.explain:
在英语中，'many' 和 'much' 都表示“许多”，但它们的使用场景不同：
- 'many' 用于可数名词。
- 'much' 用于不可数名词。
它们常用于疑问句和否定句。在肯定句中，我们更常用 'a lot of' 或 'plenty of'。

reading.cn: 莎拉正在计划一个派对。她想邀请很多人。她有充足的食物和饮料，所以每个人都可以尽情享用。她还准备了一些游戏。但是她没有太多时间来装饰。她的朋友汤姆给她打电话。“你需要帮忙吗？”汤姆问。“是的，我需要一些装饰方面的帮助，”莎拉回答。“我一会儿就到，”汤姆说。莎拉笑了。有了汤姆的帮助，她知道会有充足的时间。
reading.en: Sarah is planning a party. She wants to invite a lot of people. She has plenty of food and drinks, so everyone can enjoy. She also has a few games ready. But she doesn't have much time to decorate. Her friend, Tom, calls her. "Do you need any help?" Tom asks. "Yes, I need some help with decorations," Sarah replies. "I'll be there in a little while," Tom says. Sarah smiles. With Tom's help, she knows there will be plenty of time.

reading.cn: 派对上，有很多人。一些人在跳舞，少数人在聊天。有一点吵闹，但是每个人都很开心。莎拉感觉很棒，因为她有很多好朋友。她想，“这是一个很棒的派对！我有很多理由微笑。”
reading.en: At the party, there are a lot of people. Some people are dancing, and a few are talking. There is a little noise, but everyone is happy. Sarah feels great because she has a lot of good friends. She thinks, "This is a great party! I have plenty of reasons to smile."

reading.cn: 汤姆问莎拉，“你还有更多的饮料吗？”莎拉说，“是的，厨房里有充足的饮料。”他走到厨房，给他的朋友们拿了几杯饮料。他们不需要太多，每人只需要一点点。每个人都玩得很开心！
reading.en: Tom asks Sarah, "Do you have any more drinks?" Sarah says, "Yes, there are plenty of drinks in the kitchen." He walks to the kitchen, and gets a few drinks for his friends. They don't need much more, just a little for each person. Everyone is having a wonderful time!

reading.cn: 派对结束后，莎拉打扫干净。有一点混乱，但不多。她想，“我还有一些精力。”她收起了一些椅子和桌子。“工作很多，但乐趣也很多，”她说。
reading.en: After the party, Sarah cleans up. There is a little mess, but not much. She thinks, "I have some energy left." She puts away a few chairs and tables. "A lot of work, but a lot of fun," she says.

reading.cn: 梅的闹钟早上七点响了。她慢慢地睁开眼睛。“唉，又是一个星期一，”她抱怨道。她起床走到厨房。她的寄宿家庭妈妈史密斯太太已经在那里准备早餐了。“早上好，梅！你睡得好吗？”史密斯太太问道。梅虚弱地笑了笑。“早上好，史密斯太太。不太好。我每天早上都得靠咖啡才能完全清醒。”史密斯太太笑了。“我懂。我则靠我的茶！有新鲜的咖啡给你。还有一些吐司。”梅迅速给自己倒了一杯。浓郁的香气弥漫了整个厨房。她尝了一口。“啊，好多了！谢谢你，史密斯太太。”现在，梅准备好迎接新的一天了。
reading.en: Mei's alarm rings at 7 AM. She slowly opens her eyes. "Ugh, another Monday," she groans. She gets out of bed and walks to the kitchen. Her host mom, Mrs. Smith, is already there, making breakfast. "Good morning, Mei! Did you sleep well?" Mrs. Smith asks. Mei smiles weakly. "Morning, Mrs. Smith. Not really. I depend on coffee every morning to fully wake up." Mrs. Smith laughs. "I understand. I rely on my tea! There's fresh coffee ready for you. And some toast." Mei quickly pours herself a cup. The rich aroma fills the kitchen. She takes a sip. "Ah, much better! Thank you, Mrs. Smith." Now, Mei is ready to face the day.

Later that day, Mei is in her English class. Her teacher, Mr. Davies, is talking about daily routines. "Many people depend on their morning coffee or tea," he says. "What do you usually start your day with?" Mei thinks about her morning. She definitely depends on coffee to get started. She also relies on her dictionary app for new words. After class, she plans to look for a good café to study in.
reading.cn: 那天晚些时候，梅正在上英语课。她的老师戴维斯先生正在谈论日常生活。“很多人都依赖他们早上的咖啡或茶，”他说。“你们通常用什么开始新的一天？”梅想起了她的早晨。她当然依赖咖啡来开始新的一天。她也依赖她的词典应用程序来学习新单词。下课后，她打算找一家不错的咖啡馆去学习。
晚上，梅给她的朋友莉莉打电话。“你今天过得怎么样？”莉莉问道。“很好，但我真的很依赖咖啡，”梅回答说。“我无法想象没有咖啡的早晨。”莉莉笑了。“我同意你的看法！我也依赖它。对了，你是不是在找兼职工作？”梅没想到这个问题。“也许吧，”她说，“我会考虑的。不管怎样，我该走了。睡前我需要听一些英语播客。”梅挂断了电话，想着咖啡和新的可能性。
reading.en: In the evening, Mei calls her friend Lily. "How was your day?" Lily asks. "It was good, but I really depend on coffee," Mei replies. "I can't imagine a morning without it." Lily laughs. "I agree with you! I also depend on it. By the way, are you looking for a part-time job?" Mei didn't expect the question. "Maybe," she says. "I'll think about it. Anyway, I should go. I need to listen to some English podcasts before bed." Mei finishes her call, thinking about coffee and new possibilities.

reading.cn: 第二天早上，梅醒来时感到神清气爽。她仍然想要咖啡，但她感觉更有活力了。她拿出她的英语课本，决定复习。她想提高她的英语，这样她就可以更多地依靠自己，而不仅仅是她的字典。她想起戴维斯先生说的话：“依靠你自己。”梅笑了。她能做到。
reading.en: The next morning, Mei wakes up feeling refreshed. She still wants coffee, but she feels more energetic. She takes out her English textbook and decides to review. She wants to improve her English so she can rely on herself more, not just her dictionary. She thinks about what Mr. Davies said: "Depend on yourself." Mei smiles. She can do it.

reading.cn: 梅正在和她的寄宿家庭共进晚餐。史密斯夫人问道：“梅，你擅长做什么？”梅笑了。“嗯，我擅长做中国菜。我喜欢做饺子和炒菜。”她的寄宿妹妹莉莉说：“哇，太棒了！我做饭很糟糕，但我很擅长吃！”所有人都笑了。史密斯先生补充道：“我非常喜欢史密斯夫人做的甜点。”史密斯夫人脸红了。“我很有兴趣尝尝梅做的饺子！”莉莉惊呼。
reading.en: Mei is having dinner with her host family. Mrs. Smith asks, "Mei, what are you good at doing?" Mei smiles. "Well, I'm good at cooking Chinese food. I love making dumplings and stir-fries. My host sister, Lily, says, "Wow, that's amazing! I'm terrible at cooking, but I'm great at eating!" Everyone laughs. Mr. Smith adds, "And I'm very fond of Mrs. Smith's desserts." Mrs. Smith blushes. grammar.explain:
在英语中，我们经常使用“be + 形容词 + 介词”的结构来表达某人擅长、不擅长或对某事感兴趣。本课主要学习如何使用形容词 good, bad, terrible 搭配介词 at，后面可以跟动名词（-ing 形式）或名词，用来表达“擅长做某事”或“不擅长做某事”。

- **be good at** + 动名词/名词：表示“擅长于……”
- **be bad at** + 动名词/名词：表示“不擅长于……”
- **be terrible at** + 动名词/名词：表示“对……很糟糕/非常不擅长……”

这个结构非常实用，在日常对话中经常出现。
grammar.title: 形容词 + 介词搭配: be good/bad/terrible at + 动名词/名词

grammar.explain:
除了 good/bad/terrible at 之外，还有许多其他形容词与介词的固定搭配，用来表达不同的情感或状态。以下是一些与本课场景相关的例子：

- **be interested in** + 动名词/名词：表示“对……感兴趣”
- **be fond of** + 动名词/名词：表示“喜欢……的，对……有兴趣的”
- **be skilled in** + 动名词/名词：表示“在……方面熟练的”

grammar.explain:
在英语中，当我们要表达某事“必须被完成”、“应该被送达”等时，我们会使用情态动词 (modal verbs) 与被动语态 (passive voice) 结合的结构。这个结构是：

情态动词 (modal verb) + be + 动词的过去分词 (past participle)

常用的情态动词包括 must（必须）、should（应该）、can（可以）、may（可能）等。被动语态强调动作的承受者，而不是动作的发出者。

examples.cn: 这份报告必须在周五前完成。
examples.en: This report must be done by Friday.

examples.cn: 这封邮件应该在中午前发送。
examples.en: The email should be sent by noon.

examples.cn: 会议可以改期到下周。
examples.en: The meeting can be rescheduled to next week.

grammar.title: 情态动词 + 被动语态 (Modal Verbs + Passive Voice)

grammar.explain:
情态动词的否定形式通常是在情态动词后加 not。例如：

must not (或 mustn't): 不允许，禁止
should not (或 shouldn't): 不应该
cannot (或 can't): 不能

examples.cn: 这项任务不应该被推迟。

examples.cn: 这个项目不可能在明天前完成。

grammar.title: 情态动词的否定形式 (Negative Forms of Modal Verbs)

reading.cn: 梅在新办公室度过了忙碌的一周。周一早上，她的经理史密斯先生叫她进了办公室。“梅，我们有一个新项目，”他说，“这份报告必须在周五前完成。这是一个非常重要的客户，所以质量必须高。”梅有点紧张，但她点了点头。“是的，史密斯先生。我明白了。”周三，梅仍在努力工作。她问她的同事汤姆：“这项任务通常都这么紧急吗？”汤姆笑了笑。“有时是这样，尤其是新客户。别担心，你能做到！”梅周四工作到很晚。最后，她完成了报告。周五早上，她把报告提交给了史密斯先生。“做得好，梅！”史密斯先生说，“这份报告今天下午将发送给客户。”梅感到非常放松。
reading.en: Mei had a busy week at her new office. Her manager, Mr. Smith, called her into his office on Monday morning. "Mei, we have a new project," he said. "This report must be done by Friday. It's a very important client, so the quality must be high." Mei felt a little nervous, but she nodded. "Yes, Mr. Smith. I understand." On Wednesday, Mei was still working hard. She asked her colleague, Tom, "Is this task usually so urgent?" Tom smiled. "Sometimes, especially with new clients. Don't worry, you can do it!" Mei worked late on Thursday. Finally, she finished the report. On Friday morning, she submitted it to Mr. Smith. "Excellent work, Mei!" he said. "This report will be sent to the client this afternoon." Mei felt so relieved.

reading.cn: 梅刚开始工作的几周很有挑战性。许多事情都是新的，节奏很快。她了解到截止日期总是很重要，有些任务必须优先于其他任务。她的同事们通常都很乐于助人，让她感到更自在。到第一个月底，梅感到更自信、更有能力了。她知道她可以应对压力并交付好的结果。最初的紧张感被成就感所取代。
reading.en: Mei's first few weeks at work were challenging. Many things were new, and the pace was fast. She learned that deadlines were always important and that some tasks had to be prioritized over others. Her colleagues were generally helpful, making her feel more comfortable. By the end of her first month, Mei felt more confident and capable. She knew she could handle the pressure and deliver good results. The initial nervousness was replaced by a sense of accomplishment.

reading.cn: 一天早上，史密斯先生又给了梅一个紧急任务。“梅，这份演示文稿必须在午餐前准备好。会议在下午 1 点。”梅深吸了一口气。她立即开始工作，收集所有必要的信息。她知道时间管理是关键。她专注于最重要的几点，制作了清晰简洁的幻灯片。到下午 12:30，演示文稿准备好了。她迅速浏览了一遍，确保一切都完美无缺。“搞定！”她心想，感到一阵满足。
reading.en: One morning, Mr. Smith gave Mei another urgent task. "Mei, this presentation must be prepared by lunchtime. The meeting is at 1 PM." Mei took a deep breath. She immediately started working, gathering all the necessary information. She knew that time management was key. She focused on the most important points and created clear, concise slides. By 12:30 PM, the presentation was ready. She quickly reviewed it, making sure everything was perfect. "Done!" she thought, feeling a rush of satisfaction.

grammar.title: 形容词的顺序 (Order of Adjectives)
grammar.explain:
当多个形容词修饰一个名词时，它们通常遵循一定的顺序。这个顺序可以帮助我们更自然、清晰地描述事物。记住这个顺序能让你的英语表达更地道。常见的顺序是：
1. 评价/看法 (Opinion)：beautiful, comfortable, unique
2. 大小 (Size)：small, big, large
3. 形状 (Shape)：round, oval
4. 新旧 (Age)：old, new, antique
5. 颜色 (Color)：red, blue, white
6. 材质 (Material)：wooden, metal, velvet
7. 来源/国籍 (Origin)：American, Chinese
8. 目的 (Purpose)：sleeping (bag), reading (corner)

例：a beautiful old wooden chair (一张漂亮的旧木椅)。

grammar.explain: “I'd like...” 是 “I would like...” 的缩写，是一种非常有礼貌且自然的表达“我想要……”的方式，常用于点餐、购物或请求时。与 “I want...” 相比，它听起来更客气、更委婉。

reading.cn: 周六，梅在跳蚤市场发现了一把漂亮的老式木椅。它有一个椭圆形的椅背和柔软的天鹅绒坐垫。它不是很舒服，但梅喜欢它的复古外观。她想象着把它放在客厅的窗边。它非常适合阅读，不过她可能会加一个小而软的靠垫来增加舒适度。她还看到了一个小的、圆形的金属桌子，和椅子很搭。梅笑了，已经想象出她舒适的新阅读角。
reading.en: Mei found a beautiful old wooden chair at the flea market on Saturday. It had an oval back and soft, velvet cushions. It wasn't very comfortable, but Mei loved its antique look. She imagined it in her living room, next to the window. It would be perfect for reading, though maybe she'd add a small, soft pillow for extra comfort. She also saw a small, round, metal table that would go well with it. Mei smiled, already picturing her cozy new reading corner.

reading.cn: 梅：哦，看这把椅子！它太独特了。我喜欢它老式的木质设计。

Vendor: Yes, it's quite a special piece. A truly beautiful antique.
reading.cn: 摊主：是的，这件很特别。真是一件美丽的古董。
梅：它还有一个柔软的天鹅绒坐垫。舒服吗？

reading.cn: 摊主：作为装饰品它很好。可能不太适合整天坐。但它是一把结实、制作精良的椅子。
reading.en: Vendor: It's good for a decorative piece. Not for sitting on all day, perhaps. But it's a sturdy, well-made chair.

grammar.explain:
这是一个非常常用的英语祝福语和赠送礼物的表达。在生日、节日或任何需要送礼物表示心意的时候都可以使用。其中，“Happy birthday!”是直接的祝福语，表达“生日快乐！”；“Here's a gift for you.”是表示“这是给你的礼物”的意思。“Here's”是“Here is”的缩写，后面加单数名词；如果要送多件礼物，可以说“Here are some gifts for you.”。

这个句型可以推广到其他场合：
- Happy New Year! Here's a present for you. (新年快乐！这是送你的礼物。)
- Happy Anniversary! Here's a card for you. (周年快乐！这是送你的贺卡。)
- Here's a little something for you. (这是给你的一点小东西。—— 更随意的表达)

grammar.explain:
这句话用来表达收到礼物或帮助时，感到对方太客气了，不应该这么费心。它表示一种礼貌的推辞，但内心是感激的。在中文里，我们常说“你太客气了！”或者“你不用这么麻烦的！”。

这个表达的完整形式是 “You didn't have to do that!”，在口语中常被缩短为 “You didn't have to!”。

reading.cn: 周六早上，梅很高兴。今天是她的朋友丽莎的生日！梅准备了一个用闪亮包装纸包好的漂亮礼物和一张贺卡。她写道：“丽莎，生日快乐！希望你有一个美好的一天！”梅正要去丽莎家参加一个小型生日派对。她迫不及待地想看到丽莎打开礼物时的表情。稍后，大家会唱“生日快乐歌”，丽莎会在吹蜡烛前许个愿。
reading.en: It's Saturday morning, and Mei is excited. Today is her friend Lisa's birthday! Mei has a beautiful gift wrapped in shiny paper and a pretty card. She wrote, "Happy Birthday, Lisa! Hope you have a wonderful day!" Mei is heading to Lisa's house for a small birthday party. She can't wait to see Lisa's face when she opens the gift. Later, everyone will sing "Happy Birthday" and Lisa will make a wish before blowing out the candles.

reading.cn: 梅来到丽莎家门口。“丽莎，生日快乐！这是送你的礼物，”梅微笑着说。丽莎看起来又惊喜又开心。“哦，梅，你不用这么客气的！太谢谢你了！”丽莎小心翼翼地打开了礼物。那是一条漂亮的围巾。“太美了！我喜欢！”丽莎惊呼道。“谢谢你来参加我的生日派对，也谢谢你这份美好的礼物。”梅看到丽莎这么喜欢她的礼物，感到很开心。接着，更多的朋友也带着礼物和美好的祝愿到来了。
reading.en: Mei arrived at Lisa's door. "Happy birthday, Lisa! Here's a gift for you," Mei said with a big smile. Lisa looked surprised and happy. "Oh, Mei, you didn't have to! Thank you so much!" Lisa carefully opened the gift. It was a lovely scarf. "It's beautiful! I love it!" Lisa exclaimed. "Thank you for coming and for this wonderful present." Mei felt happy that Lisa liked her gift so much. Then, more friends arrived, bringing more gifts and good wishes.

reading.cn: 派对很热闹。他们吃蛋糕，分享故事，开怀大笑。丽莎许了愿，吹灭了蜡烛，大家欢呼起来。这是一个完美的生日庆典。
reading.en: The party was fun. They ate cake, shared stories, and laughed a lot. Lisa made her wish, blew out the candles, and everyone cheered. It was a perfect birthday celebration.

reading.cn: 梅离开前，丽莎拥抱了她。“梅，再次感谢你所做的一切。你让我的今天很特别。”梅笑了笑。“随时都可以，丽莎。再次祝你生日快乐！”
reading.en: Before Mei left, Lisa hugged her. "Thank you again for everything, Mei. You made my day special." Mei smiled. "Anytime, Lisa. Happy birthday again!"

output.sample: It's so sad to see you go! I'm really going to miss you. Let's promise to keep in touch. I'll call you every week and we can video chat sometimes. Take care, and come visit me soon!
output.cn: 想象你正在和一位搬到另一个城市的好朋友告别。写一段短信息（3-5句话），表达你的感受以及你打算如何保持联系。
output.prompt: Imagine you are saying goodbye to a good friend who is moving to another city. Write a short message (3-5 sentences) expressing your feelings and how you plan to stay in touch.

reading.en: Mei was at the airport, ready to fly back home after her exchange program. Her host family, the Lees, came to see her off. Mrs. Lee hugged Mei. "It was so nice having you, Mei. Please let's stay in touch!" Mei smiled, her eyes a little teary. "I will! I'll email you often. Thank you for everything." Mr. Lee added, "We'll miss you, Mei. Take care." Their son, Tom, waved enthusiastically. "See you around, Mei! Come visit us again!" As Mei walked to her gate, she looked back and waved one last time. It was hard to say goodbye, but she knew they would keep in touch.
reading.cn: 梅在机场，准备在她的交换项目结束后飞回家。她的寄宿家庭李一家来送她。李太太拥抱了梅。“梅，有你真好。请我们保持联系！”梅笑了，眼睛有点湿润。“我会的！我会经常给你们发邮件。谢谢你们所做的一切。”李先生补充说，“梅，我们会想你的。保重。”他们的儿子汤姆热情地挥手。“回头见，梅！再来我们家玩！”当梅走向登机口时，她最后一次回头挥手。道别很难，但她知道他们会保持联系。

reading.en: A few weeks later, Mei sent an email to the Lees. "Hi everyone! I miss you all! How are you? I'm settling back home, but I often think about my time with you. I hope to come back and visit next year. Let's keep in touch!" Mrs. Lee replied quickly. "Dear Mei, so good to hear from you! We miss you too. We'd love for you to visit. We'll always stay in touch!" Mei felt warm, knowing their connection would continue.
reading.cn: 几周后，梅给李一家发了一封邮件。“大家好！我想你们大家！你们好吗？我正在家里安顿下来，但我经常想起和你们在一起的时光。我希望能明年回来探望。我们保持联系吧！”李太太很快回复了。“亲爱的梅，很高兴收到你的来信！我们也想你。我们很乐意你来探望。我们永远保持联系！”梅感到很温暖，知道他们的联系会继续下去。

reading.en: Even months later, Mei and the Lees exchanged messages, sharing updates about their lives. Sometimes, they even had video calls. They proved that saying goodbye wasn't the end, but the beginning of a long-distance friendship. They truly knew how to stay in touch.
reading.cn: 即使几个月后，梅和李一家仍然互通消息，分享彼此生活的最新情况。有时，他们甚至还会进行视频通话。他们证明了道别不是结束，而是一段异地友谊的开始。他们真的知道如何保持联系。
梅学到了宝贵的一课：告别可能很难，但只要努力，联系就可以持久。她很感激她的寄宿家庭以及他们之间分享的纽带。她知道她会永远记住他们，最重要的是，他们会永远保持联系。
reading.en: Mei learned a valuable lesson: goodbyes can be hard, but with effort, connections can last. She was grateful for her host family and the bond they shared. She knew she would always remember them and, most importantly, they would always stay in touch.

listening.audio: Mei was at the airport, saying goodbye to her host family. Mrs. Lee hugged her and said, 'Please let's stay in touch!' Mei promised, 'I'll email you often!' Mr. Lee added, 'We'll miss you, Mei. Take care.'

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.explain:
现在完成进行时表示一个动作从过去某个时间开始，一直持续到现在，并且可能还会继续下去。它强调动作的持续性。

结构：subject + have/has + been + verb-ing

常与 for (持续多长时间) 或 since (从某个时间点开始) 连用。

examples.en: I've been waiting here for 30 minutes.
examples.cn: 我在这里已经等了30分钟了。（强调持续的等待）

examples.en: I've waited for you.
examples.cn: 我等你等过了。（强调等待这个事实，可能已经结束）

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 vs. 现在完成时
grammar.explain:
现在完成进行时强调动作的持续性和过程，而现在完成时则强调动作的结果或完成。

现在完成进行时: "I've been reading this book." (我一直在读这本书，可能还没读完)
现在完成时: "I've read this book." (我已经读完这本书了)

reading.cn: 梅已经在咖啡店等了快一个小时了。她的朋友大卫和她的咖啡约会迟到了很久。梅又看了一眼手表。“呃，大卫！你在哪里？”她小声对自己说。她开始失去耐心。她已经期待这次见面一整个星期了。终于，大卫匆匆忙忙地走了进来，看起来很慌乱。“梅，对不起！我一直堵在路上，路完全被堵住了。”梅叹了口气。“没关系，但我已经等了一个小时了！”大卫再次道歉，然后迅速点了两杯咖啡和一些糕点来弥补他的迟到。
reading.en: Mei has been waiting at the coffee shop for almost an hour. Her friend, David, is very late for their coffee date. Mei checks her watch again. "Ugh, David! Where are you?" she whispers to herself. She's starting to lose patience. She's been looking forward to this meet-up all week. Finally, David rushes in, looking flustered. " Mei, I'm so sorry! I've been stuck in traffic. The road was completely blocked." Mei sighs. "It's okay, but I've been waiting for an hour!" David apologizes again and quickly orders two coffees and some pastries to make up for his lateness.

listening.audio: Mei has been waiting here for a long time. She's been reading a magazine to pass the time. Finally, David arrives, apologizing profusely. He says he's been stuck in heavy traffic for almost an hour.

reading.cn: 梅下定决心要提高她的英语。她每天练习口语，即使感到疲惫。她知道这很有挑战性，但她有很强的动力。她的英语老师总是告诉她：“你练习得越多，就会进步越大。”梅还阅读英语书籍，看英语电影。她相信她接触这种语言越多，她就会越流利。日积月累，她的努力正在得到回报。她能感觉到她的技能一天天在提高。她对自己的进步感到兴奋，并且知道只要继续努力，她就会实现流利说英语的目标。
reading.en: Mei is very determined to improve her English. She practices speaking every day, even when she feels tired. She knows it's challenging, but she has strong motivation. Her English teacher always tells her, "The more you practice, the better you get." Mei also reads English books and watches English movies. She believes that the more she exposes herself to the language, the more fluent she will become. Slowly but surely, her efforts are paying off. She can feel her skills improving day by day. She's excited about her progress and knows that with continued effort, she will achieve her goal of becoming fluent.

reading.cn: 梅的朋友利亚姆问她：“梅，你的英语越来越好了！有什么秘诀吗？”梅微笑着回答：“很简单，利亚姆。我学得越多，学到的就越多。我说得越多，就感觉越自信。我犯的错误越多，就进步越大！不要害怕尝试。”利亚姆点点头，明白持续练习是关键。“你说得对，”他说，“我尝试得越多，就会变得越容易。”
reading.en: Mei's friend, Liam, asks her, "Mei, your English is getting so good! What's your secret?" Mei smiles and replies, "It's simple, Liam. The more I study, the more I learn. The more I speak, the more confident I feel. And the more mistakes I make, the more I improve! Don't be afraid to try." Liam nods, understanding that consistent practice is key. "You're right," he says. "The more I try, the easier it will become."

reading.cn: 梅不断提醒自己，掌握一门语言是一段旅程。她致力于保持持之以恒，因为她知道她练习得越规律，她的进步就越快。她发现她听母语者说得越多，她的发音就越好。她写得越多，她的思路就越清晰。她的奉献精神是她朋友们的榜样，向他们展示了你付出的努力越多，回报就越大。 Limit reading to 2-3 paragraphs.
reading.en: Mei continues to remind herself that mastering a language is a journey. She aims to be consistent, knowing that the more regularly she practices, the faster her progress will be. She finds that the more she listens to native speakers, the better her pronunciation becomes. And the more she writes, the clearer her thoughts are. Her dedication is an inspiration to her friends, showing them that the more effort you put in, the greater the reward.

reading.cn: 梅知道学习英语需要耐心。她告诉自己：“我越有耐心，就越能享受学习过程。”她还相信，她在学习时玩得越开心，她的动力就越大。所以，她尝试通过看有趣的节目和和朋友聊天来让学习变得愉快。“我越喜欢它，就越想学习！”她总结道。
reading.en: Mei knows that learning English requires patience. She tells herself, "The more patient I am, the more I will enjoy the learning process." She also believes that the more fun she has while learning, the more motivated she will be. So, she tries to make her learning enjoyable by watching interesting shows and talking with friends. "The more I enjoy it, the more I want to learn!" she concludes.

grammar.explain: 这个句型表示“越……就越……”的意思，用来描述两个事物或情况之间的一种因果关系，一个的变化导致另一个的变化。它通常由“The + 比较级形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语”构成。

grammar.title: 关于 'more' 和其他比较级
grammar.explain: 在这个句型中，'more' 后面可以直接跟名词来表示“更多的……”，或者跟形容词/副词的原级来构成比较级。对于单音节形容词/副词或部分双音节词，直接加“-er”构成比较级。

Then, she remembered Jenny wore a similar scarf yesterday. "It must be Jenny's scarf!" she realized. Mei went to find Jenny and returned the scarf. Jenny was very happy. "Thank you, Mei! I was looking for it everywhere!"

grammar.explain:
在英语中，我们用 "used to" 和 "would" 来描述过去经常发生但现在不再发生的事情，或者过去的习惯。它们都表示“过去常常”或“以前会”。

**Used to:**
1. 可以描述过去经常发生的动作（习惯）。
   例如：I used to play basketball every day. (我以前每天都打篮球。)
2. 可以描述过去的状态（非动作性动词），而 "would" 通常不可以。
   例如：I used to live in a small town. (我以前住在一个小镇。) - 这里不能用 "would"。

grammar.title: Used to vs. Would: 描述过去的习惯和状态
Would: 描述过去的重复性动作
grammar.explain:
Would 主要用于描述过去反复发生的动作或习惯，但它不能用于描述过去的状态。它通常用在叙述故事或回忆时，让描述更生动。

**Would (强调重复性动作):**
1. 只能描述过去重复性的动作，不能描述状态。
   例如：Every Sunday, we would go to the park. (每个星期天，我们都会去公园。)
2. 常与时间短语（如 every day, often, sometimes）一起使用，表示频率。

examples.cn: 我小时候，奶奶每晚都会给我讲故事。
examples.en: When I was a child, my grandmother would tell me stories every night.
We would often go fishing together.
examples.cn: 我们以前经常一起去钓鱼。
夏天的时候，我们总是会在湖里游泳。
examples.en: In the summer, we would always swim in the lake.

grammar.title: 总结区别:
grammar.explain:
**Used to 可以描述动作和状态，would 只能描述动作。**

- **Used to** 可以替换 **would** 来描述重复性动作。
  例如：I used to play basketball. = I would play basketball. (✓)

- **Would 不可以** 替换 **used to** 来描述状态。
  例如：I used to live in a small town. ≠ I would live in a small town. (✕)

reading.cn: 梅正在翻看一些旧照片。她看到一张自己在篮球场上的照片。“哇，”她想，“我年轻的时候每天都打篮球！放学后，我总是会和朋友们去公园。我们会一直玩到天黑。那时我真活跃啊。”她笑着，回忆起那些有趣的日子。“我以前还经常骑自行车去任何地方，”她回忆道。“那真是美好的日子。我很想念那种无忧无虑的感觉。”她感到有些怀旧。
梅的朋友莉莉给她打电话。“你在干什么呢？”莉莉问。梅告诉她关于照片的事。“哦，我记得！”莉莉说，“我们以前篮球打得可好了。而且每年夏天，我们都会去社区游泳池游泳。你还记得吗？”梅笑了。“是的！我们之后总是会去吃冰淇淋！”她们都开心地回忆着自己的童年。
reading.en: Mei's friend, Lily, called her. "What are you doing?" Lily asked. Mei told her about the photos. "Oh, I remember that!" Lily said. "We used to be so good at basketball. And every summer, we would go swimming at the community pool. Do you remember?" Mei laughed. "Yes! And we would always get ice cream afterward!" They both felt happy remembering their childhood.

Mei said, "Maybe we should start playing basketball again. It would be fun!" Lily replied, "That's a great idea! I used to enjoy it so much. Let's find a time next week." Mei felt excited. It was nice to think about reliving a bit of her active past.
reading.cn: 梅说：“也许我们应该重新开始打篮球。那会很有趣！”莉莉回答说：“好主意！我以前非常喜欢打篮球。我们下周找个时间吧。”梅感到很兴奋。能想到重温她活跃的过去，感觉真好。

reading.en: In the end, Mei and Lily made plans to play basketball. It made Mei realize that while the past is nice to remember, creating new memories can be just as good. She also thought about how important it is to stay active, even if not every day like she used to.
reading.cn: 最后，梅和莉莉制定了打篮球的计划。这让梅意识到，虽然过去值得回忆，但创造新的回忆同样美好。她还想到保持活跃的重要性，即使不能像以前那样每天都打篮球。

reading.cn: 梅是这个城市的新居民。她需要去火车站取一个包裹。她在街上叫住了一个看起来很友善的陌生人。“打扰一下，”她礼貌地说道，“能告诉我车站在哪吗？”
reading.en: Mei was new to the city. She needed to go to the train station to pick up a package. She stopped a kind-looking stranger on the street. "Excuse me," she said politely. "Could you tell me where the station is?"

reading.cn: 陌生人笑了。“当然。直走两个街区，然后右转。你会在你的左手边看到车站。它就在大超市的对面。”梅感谢了她。“非常感谢！”她说，“我真的很感谢你的帮助。”
reading.en: The stranger smiled. "Sure. Go straight for two blocks, then turn right. You'll see the station on your left. It's across from the big supermarket." Mei thanked her. "Thank you so much!" she said. "I really appreciate your help."

reading.cn: 梅按照指引，很轻松地找到了车站。她想，“问路的时候有礼貌很重要。当你好好问的时候，人们总是乐意帮忙的。”
reading.en: Mei followed the directions and found the station easily. She thought, "It's important to be polite when asking for directions. People are always willing to help when you ask nicely."

reading.cn: 她取了包裹，决定稍微探索一下附近。她看到附近一家小咖啡馆，就进去喝杯咖啡。
reading.en: She picked up her package and decided to explore the area a little. She saw a small coffee shop nearby and went in for a cup of coffee.

reading.en: Mei and her friend, Liam, are at a university talent show. The stage lights are bright. A young woman walks onto the stage. She smiles at the audience, takes a deep breath, and starts to sing. Her voice is clear and strong. Mei whispers to Liam, 'What a voice! She's so talented.' Liam nods, 'Absolutely! This song is perfect for her.' After her song, the audience claps loudly. Everyone is standing and giving a big round of applause. Liam says, 'That was an amazing performance. Really impressive!' Mei agrees, 'I hope she wins! She truly deserves it.' They both feel happy to witness such a great talent.

reading.cn: 梅在超市里，为晚餐寻找食材。当她看到一位老太太正费力地够着货架顶层的麦片盒时，手里已经拎着几个沉甸甸的袋子。梅犹豫了一下，然后走了过去。
reading.en: Mei was at the supermarket, looking for some ingredients for dinner. She had a few heavy bags in her hands when she saw an elderly lady struggling to reach a box of cereal on the top shelf. Mei hesitated for a moment, then walked over.

reading.cn: “打扰一下，”梅礼貌地说。“我能帮你吗？”
reading.en: "Excuse me," Mei said politely. "Can I help you with that?"

reading.cn: 老太太看着梅，微笑着。“哦，那太好了，亲爱的。这对我来说有点太高了。”梅迅速够到麦片盒，递给了她。
reading.en: The lady looked at Mei and smiled. "Oh, that would be wonderful, dear. It's a bit too high for me." Mei quickly reached for the cereal box and handed it to her.

reading.cn: “非常感谢你！”老太太说，眼睛里闪烁着。“你真好。”
reading.en: "Thank you so much!" the lady said, her eyes twinkling. "You're very kind."

reading.cn: 梅感到一股暖流传遍全身。“不客气。还有什么我可以帮你找的吗？”
reading.en: Mei felt a warmth spread through her. "You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you find?"

grammar.title: That's a wrap! (口语化表达“结束了/搞定了”)
grammar.explain: “That's a wrap!”是一个非常地道的口语表达，意思是“这就结束了”、“圆满完成了”或者“搞定了”。它常用于宣布一项任务、活动或项目已经成功结束。在电影制作中，当一天的拍摄或整个电影拍摄完成时，导演会说“That's a wrap!”。在日常生活中，当完成某项工作或学习阶段后，也可以用它来表达事情的完成。

examples.cn: 我们把所有家庭作业都做完了。搞定了！
examples.en: We finished all the homework. That's a wrap!

examples.cn: 会议结束了。今天的工作告一段落。
examples.en: The meeting is over. That's a wrap for today.

examples.cn: 两年之后，我的 A2 英语课程圆满结束了！
examples.en: After two years, my A2 English course is a wrap!

grammar.title: 回顾过去完成时的应用 (Past Perfect Review)
grammar.explain: 在回顾和总结经历时，我们经常会用到过去完成时 (Past Perfect)。它用于表示在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作。回顾 A2 旅程，我们用过去完成时来描述在“现在回顾”这个过去时间点之前，你已经完成的学习、经历或感受。结构是: had + 动词的过去分词 (V3)。

examples.cn: 在我开始 A2 之前，我只知道几个英语单词。
examples.en: Before I started A2, I had only known a few English words.

examples.cn: 梅感到自豪，因为她学到了很多。
examples.en: Mei felt proud because she had learned so much.

examples.cn: 到 A2 结束时，我变得更加自信了。
examples.en: By the end of A2, I had become much more confident.

listening.audio: Mei just finished her A2 English course! She felt very proud of her progress. It was a rewarding journey, and she had learned so much. Now, she is ready for the next step: B1. She knows there is always more to learn beyond what she has achieved.

I've also learned many new words and grammar rules. My next step is to speak more fluently and write better emails. I'm excited for B1!
output.prompt: Write a short paragraph (3-5 sentences) reflecting on your own English learning journey so far. What have you achieved? What are you proud of? What's your 'next step'?
output.cn: 写一段短文（3-5句），反思你自己的英语学习之旅。你取得了什么成就？你为哪些方面感到自豪？你的“下一步”是什么？

reading.cn: 回首自己的英语学习之旅，梅充满成就感。“A2 课程圆满结束了！”她想着，微笑着。“这是一次非常有意义的经历。”她想起第一堂课时自己紧张不安的心情。而现在，她已经能够听懂对话，问路，甚至表达自己的看法。她的寄宿家庭也注意到了她的进步。“梅，你真的进步了很多，”史密斯太太昨天晚饭时说。梅回顾了自己学到的所有新单词、语法规则和表达方式。她现在感觉更自信了。下一步是 B1，她对未来的学习充满期待。“我准备好迎接新的挑战了！”她对自己轻声说道。
reading.en: Mei felt a sense of accomplishment as she looked back at her English learning journey. "That's a wrap on A2!" she thought, smiling. "It's been a rewarding experience." She remembered her first lesson, feeling nervous and unsure. Now, she could understand conversations, ask for directions, and even share her opinions. Her host family had noticed her progress too. "You've really come a long way, Mei," Mrs. Smith said yesterday at dinner. Mei reflected on all the new words, grammar rules, and expressions she had learned. She felt more confident now. The next step was B1, and she was excited for what lay beyond. "I'm ready for new challenges!" she whispered to herself.

reading.cn: 梅决定通过列出自己的成就清单来庆祝她的 A2 毕业。她写下了：点咖啡、询问火车时刻、谈论爱好以及理解日常对话。她还记下了在 B1 阶段想要提高的内容，比如更流利地说话和写更长的电子邮件。“这不仅仅是关于语法和词汇，”她提醒自己，“更是关于与人建立联系和理解世界。”她拿起手机，给她的学习伙伴莎拉发信息：“A2 毕业啦！我们找时间庆祝一下！”莎拉立刻回复：“太棒了！为你感到骄傲！”梅知道她的学习之旅仍将继续，她期待着下一个篇章。
reading.en: Mei decided to celebrate her A2 graduation by making a list of her achievements. She wrote down: ordering coffee, asking about train times, talking about her hobbies, and understanding daily conversations. She also noted down things she wanted to improve in B1, like speaking more fluently and writing longer emails. "It's not just about grammar and vocabulary," she reminded herself. "It's about connecting with people and understanding the world." She picked up her phone and texted her study buddy, Sarah: "A2's done! Let's celebrate soon!" Sarah replied immediately: "Awesome! So proud of you!" Mei knew her learning journey would continue, and she was eager for the next chapter.

reading.cn: 梅为自己感到无比自豪。学习过程并非一帆风顺。有时她会觉得卡壳，或者被复杂的语法搞糊涂。但她没有放弃。她每天练习，看英语电影，并尽可能多地与寄宿家庭交流。现在回首，她看到了自己取得了多大的进步。世界似乎变得小了一点，也更容易理解了一点。她合上笔记本，一种平静的满足感涌上心头。“B1，我来了！”她想道，一股新的兴奋感涌上心头。
reading.en: Mei felt incredibly proud of herself. It wasn't always easy. There were times when she felt stuck, or confused by complex grammar. But she didn't give up. She practiced every day, watched English movies, and talked with her host family as much as possible. Now, looking back, she saw how far she had come. The world seemed a little bit smaller, a little bit more understandable. She closed her notebook, a feeling of quiet satisfaction settling over her. "B1, here I come!" she thought, a new wave of excitement washing over her.

reading.cn: 当梅思考她的语言学习时，她明白 A2 毕业并非终点，而是一个新的开始。她微笑着，拿起她最喜欢的英文小说，开始阅读。她已准备好继续她的冒险。
reading.en: As Mei thought about her language learning, she understood that graduation from A2 was not the end, but a new beginning. She smiled, picked up her favorite English novel, and started reading. She was ready to continue her adventure.
